name: Desktop Mate
lang: Japanese*, English*
short: A little more joy on your desktop, every day. Always with the characters you love—they sit on your windows, play with your mouse cursor, and respond to head pats. Featuring a built-in alarm and in-game sync, with new officially licensed character DLCs released regularly!
about: Stay close to the characters you love—right on your desktop.          A little more joy on your desktop, every day.   Always together with your favorite characters.  They sit on top of your windows, tell you the time, and more.  Your everyday desktop, just a little happier.     Popular Character DLC—More on the Way!          What Makes Your Desktop More Fun               Drag a character onto a window, and they'll sit right on top of it. Just watching them jump from window to window is soothing. A core feature of Desktop Mate—stay together even while you work.                 Characters react to your mouse cursor by chasing and playing with it. Their charming gestures add a touch of fun to your desktop.                 Characters play voice lines in various scenes! With voices for clicks, head pats, and other interactions, it feels as if they're really there.  * Voice content varies by DLC character.                 The built-in alarm feature lets your characters tell you when it's time! Set an alarm, and your characters will let you know when it goes off!  * Some DLCs include special mascot characters that appear when alarms go off.                 The multi-character feature lets you display several characters at once! Line up your favorites on your desktop and enjoy them together.  *This feature is currently available only in the beta version.                 Special actions trigger between certain character pairs! For example, displaying Kagamine Rin/Len together unlocks playful exchanges and synchronized movements only the twins can perform.  * More character combos coming in future updates.                   Syncs with "Mahjong Soul"! Desktop Mate characters react in real time to in-game actions.  * This feature requires the Mahjong Soul "Chibi Ichihime" DLC.                 Every feature is thoughtfully designed to never disrupt your day. Make characters bigger to enjoy their presence, or smaller to keep things tidy. When not in use, they quietly tuck away at the edge of your screen—keeping things comfortable, even for long sessions.      Latest News  Desktop Mate keeps growing with new characters and features.  From new ways to interact with characters to handy new features, Desktop Mate keeps evolving.  Follow our official X account (@desktop_mate) for the latest updates!

name: MateEngine
lang: English*, Spanish - Spain, Japanese*, Russian, French, German, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese*
short: MateEngine is a lightweight desktop companion app with full custom VRM model support. Bring 3D anime-style characters to life on your screen with idle animations, drag and dance features, and low resource usage and open-source.
about: MateEngine    MateEngine  is a lightweight, customizable desktop companion app that brings 3D anime-style characters to life on your screen. Built with VRM model support, it allows you to inject your own avatars and watch them interact, idle, and even dance—right from your desktop.    This project is a alternative aimed at giving users more control and flexibility without relying on expensive model packs or locked-down systems. Whether you want a simple virtual presence or a more animated character hanging out while you work, MateEngine is designed to be approachable and performance-friendly.   VRM Models / Frequently Asked Question    Important:  This app includes the default model "Zome." Hatsune Miku is  not  included.  To use custom models, you must download them from websites that offer .vrm files, or commission artists who create or convert models to the VRM format.  I am not responsible for the quality of third-party models. If you experience clipping or similar issues, the model's author is responsible, not this app.       RELAXE ON WINDOWS           Drag your pet onto a window and it will relax on top! Perfect for watching videos she'll watch with you. Or let her quietly spy while you do your homework, hehe.   This feature is experimental and not fully developed. Please avoid using it with apps that have anti-cheat protection enabled.    DANCING           She will start dancing when you play music! You can decide which apps are allowed to trigger dancing.  Open the Options menu, go to the audio sources, and whitelist your music apps.   Tip:  Start the music app first (e.g. Spotify), then open the menu and add it to the source list!     HEAD AND SPINE MOVEMENT           Not just the head — her eyes, head, and spine all follow your mouse cursor!  This makes the movement look smooth and natural compared to other desktop pets.     HAND MOVEMENT           Careful! Sometimes she’ll try to grab your mouse — hehe!  Move your cursor near her hands or arms and watch her try to catch it!     TOUCH REGIONS           Hover your mouse over sensitive areas like the head or belly to trigger cute gestures!  For example, hovering over her head makes her giggle and spawn sparkle effects, making her feel comfy.     CHATTING           You can chat with your pet anytime! Just note that it’s a small, local AI with simple messages.  For more complex conversations, you can use mods with your own models and messages!     RELAXING           When you drag her to the taskbar, she’ll lay down and relax on a big candy macaron, watching your mouse cursor with sleepy eyes.     DRAGGING           You can reposition her by clicking and dragging her with your mouse.  Just hold the button down and move her wherever you like!     CHIBI MODE           Hold your mouse over her feet for a few seconds and she’ll transform into a tiny,  adorable chibi version of herself — extra smol and cute!   CUSTOMIZATIONS           You can change her size, animation speed, language, and modes.  There are also graphics and FPS settings for low-end (potato) PCs!   DARK MODE           You can turn off lighting — perfect for VRM models with emissive textures!  Pair it with the glow/bloom toggle and your pet will shine like a diamond in the dark   MODDING           Modding is supported! Load your own VRM model by pressing the VRM button. If your model doesn’t load, it’s likely corrupted or not exported correctly. Make sure to export using the correct format:     VRM0.X : Uses  MToon Shader      VRM1.X : Uses  MToon10 Shader  Also make sure your model uses a proper humanoid bone setup. MateEngine follows the  official VRM loading specification , so model issues are not caused by the app.     How To Use    It’s easy!  Just start MateEngine and you’ll be greeted by Zome.  Right-click Zome to open the Options menu — here you can change graphics, effects, audio, and choose which apps make the pet dance. name: Wartide
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Portuguese - Portugal, Traditional Chinese
short: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.
about: One war, two sizes  WARTIDE runs as a small always-on-top widget in the corner of your screen while you work, browse or watch. When the swarm arrives, go full screen and take command. Same battle, same save, your choice of size.          Hold the line from every direction  No lanes. Enemies close in from 360 degrees, wave after wave, with all-out assaults, enemy commanders and night attacks. Your army has a cap, so where you deploy and what you field matters more than how much  Evolve your army through three eras          Start with WWII halftracks and Shermans. Evolve eight vehicle lines (recon, carriers, tanks, tank destroyers, artillery, air defence, helicopters and jets) through the Cold War to modern armor, open every vehicle in your garage, and file every unit you meet in the codex.  Call in the big guns  Strafing runs, cluster bombs, carpet bombing, rocket artillery. Commander abilities (artillery barrage, smoke screen, reinforcements) unlock and grow stronger as you prestige.  Conquer the campaign, survive the outbreak  Take 14 regions on the campaign map for lasting bonuses, all the way to the capital at wave 150. Then switch to Outbreak mode: build turrets, hold the shelter and survive a horde of thousands.  Good to know    Single-player, Windows. Runs as a resizable desktop widget or full screen. Cloud saves.    Idle-friendly: your army fights on its own, auto-command keeps the line manned. All-out assaults and the later eras still need your decisions.    Every run pays: Micro Conductors from a lost run buy permanent upgrades, and each one takes you further. Nuke a strong run (prestige) for new headquarters buildings and commander abilities.      Pin it. Play it. Let the war rage on.

name: Chess Kingdom
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Hindi, Arabic, Czech, Hungarian, Indonesian, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Swedish
short: A hundred chess games on Steam. One of them gives you 40 AI opponents up to 2550 Elo, live open lobbies, async play, a league mode, a mini board that sits on your desktop and lessons that turn beginners into threats. You already know which one this is.
about: Most chess apps teach you the basics and leave you hanging. Most chess games are fun but won't make you better. Chess Kingdom does both. Whether you've never touched a chess board or you're looking for your next real challenge, this is where you grow.   START ANYWHERE. KEEP IMPROVING.   Six structured training campaigns take you from absolute beginner to advanced player, each focused on a specific part of the game. Piece movement. Tactics. Openings. Middlegame strategy. Endgames. Deep calculation. Hand-crafted lessons and puzzles, carefully ordered so every concept builds on the last. No guessing what to study next. No jumping in the deep end. Just clear, satisfying progress with star ratings, XP, and titles to show for it.       CLIMB THE LEAGUE   League Mode is a football-style division system with 6 tiers, from Wooden Shield to Diamond Crown. Play a full season against the AI opponents in your division. Finish 1st to promote. Finish last and face relegation. Earn trophies, collect stars, and climb your way to the top. Win Division 1 and you unlock a 2-game showdown against Phantom, the hidden League Champion. Can you claim the crown?       THEN COMES THE REAL TEST   Training and League are just the beginning. Chess Kingdom gives you every reason to keep playing.    40 AI opponents, each with a distinct personality, playstyle, and country. From Daisy the friendly beginner to Titan the ruthless master, and two secret opponents to unlock.    Tournaments. Single Elimination, Round Robin, Swiss. Climb a bracket. Prove your ranking.    Elimination Mode. Win or go home. One loss ends your run. How far can you get?    Async Online Multiplayer. Challenge friends via Steam and make your move whenever you're ready. No need to be online at the same time.    Daily Puzzles and Puzzle Rush. Stay sharp every day.    Play Kung Fu Chess: a real-time mode where both players move at the same time with no turns, or go Extreme and earn buffs, unlock power tiers, and unleash double moves by playing aggressively.    Atomic Chess: a tactical new variant where every capture detonates a 3×3 explosion, kings can't capture, and blowing up the enemy king wins the game instantly.    Game Analysis. See exactly where you won or lost, move by move.         MAKE IT YOURS   Choose your country from more then 40 nations, each with a unique piece set inspired by that country's culture and art. Indian Mughal pieces. Japanese Shogi-influenced designs. Dutch Delft-style boards. Your flag in your profile. Your style on the board. Unlock more as you level up through 100 player levels: piece sets, board themes, backgrounds, and titles earned through real progress.       BUILT TO GROW WITH YOU   Chess Kingdom is built by a solo developer using AI-assisted development, which means faster updates, more content, and the ability to act quickly on what the community asks for. New country skins, training content, and features are added regularly. Your feedback directly shapes what comes next.       ONE GAME. EVERY LEVEL.   Chess Kingdom grows with you. The beginner finishing their first lesson and the player grinding League Mode for the Diamond Crown are playing the same game, just a different chapter of it. The board is set. How far will you go?

Build a cozy capsule space, connect with others online, and let your NANO thrive while you work, game, or relax.               In the future,  NanoCorp  revolutionized society with  NANOs  - advanced androids designed to work, protect, and evolve. But their greatest discovery wasn’t in circuits or code - it was in connection.  As a  Handler , your bond with your NANO determines its growth, efficiency, and potential. The stronger your connection, the more your NANO thrives - and so does the world around you.                              Customize your NANO   Personalize your NANO’s appearance to match your style. Upgrade and enhance them as they grow alongside you.           Build & Decorate a Capsule Home   Design a cozy, futuristic capsule where your NANO lives. Decorate with furniture, gadgets, and upgrades to create the perfect space.           Play mini games to earn!   Assign your NANO different tasks and jobs - whether it’s crafting, gathering, assisting with research, or even taking on unique missions. They can earn rewards and income for you to spend on more customisation!                       Discord Integration    Turn your Discord server into living social hubs. Jump in with your friends, explore, and play together inside Nano Neighbors — even if they don’t own the game. It’s a new way to hang out, play, and build community without ever leaving Discord!          Invite Friends & Visit Their NANOs   Interact with your friends’ NANOs, visit their capsules, or invite them over to yours. Watch how their NANOs grow and evolve in different ways.           Seamless Desktop Integration   Let your NANO live on your screen while you work, study, or browse. Whether actively engaging or passively watching, your NANO is always there.   Twitch Integration   Streamers can let their viewers interact with their NANO using chat commands - helping with tasks, sending gifts, or even joining their capsule home to keep them company.   And Cute interactable Nanos!

name: Desktop Companion
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Latin America*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian, Spanish - Spain**
short: The most powerful AI companion on your desktop: it sees your screen, searches the live web, writes your files, opens your apps, reads and replies to your Twitch chat, and remembers every conversation. Runs entirely on your PC: no account, no key, no subscription. Windows only.
about: Desktop Companion is the most powerful AI companion that lives on your desktop: an always-on-top avatar that sees your screen, works the live web, and remembers every conversation, building a real relationship over time. Not another AI chatbot stuck in a browser tab, but a real on-screen presence, always one glance away. Everything runs on your own machine, right out of the box: no account, no key, no setup.     Before you buy: hardware requirements   Desktop Companion runs entirely locally on your own PC (or on another machine on your local network). It requires a recent  dedicated graphics card with at least 10 GB of VRAM ; 12 GB or more is recommended. Integrated graphics, found in most thin laptops, are not supported.  Results may vary depending on your hardware and the model you use.      It lives on top of everything   Your companion floats above every window (games, apps, browsers), always one glance away. A real desktop presence, not a tab you alt-tab to.     It doesn't just answer, it acts   Ask for something and it goes and does it. It searches the live web and reads real pages, so it answers with today's information instead of stale training data, with nothing to sign up for and nothing to configure. It tracks what's blowing up on Reddit and X, checks the weather, and opens your apps and your folders. And when there's something worth keeping, it writes the file itself: a quick note, a Word document, a full spreadsheet, saved and ready to open. One request, and the work is done.     It sees your screen   Show it anything on screen and it reads it straight from a screenshot: a game, a chart, a line of code, a menu in another language. Point it at a chess position and it'll walk you through your next move. Screen vision runs on the built-in model, on your own graphics card, so what's on your screen stays on your machine.     Your Twitch co-host   Connect your Twitch account in one click and your companion joins your stream as a live AI co-host: it reads your chat and replies to your viewers in character, out loud, with moderation controls you set. Bring your own VTuber model and never stream to dead air again.     It remembers you   Real long-term memory. It keeps what matters from your conversations and brings it back days later. Close it, come back, and it picks up exactly where you left off.     It runs entirely on your machine   Desktop Companion comes with its own AI model, built in and ready the moment it's installed. Nothing to download, no account to create, no key to paste, no credits to buy, no monthly bill. Every reply is generated on your own graphics card, and your conversations stay on your machine. Unplug the network cable and it keeps working exactly the same. One purchase, and it's yours.     It speaks, and you can clone a voice   Three text-to-speech engines are included and run side by side, all of them local and free: Pocket-TTS, Kokoro and OmniVoice. Clone a voice on your own machine and give every character its own: in high quality with OmniVoice, or on the CPU alone with Pocket-TTS. Nothing is sent anywhere. Live captions show every spoken line in the language you choose, so it can speak one language while you read along in another. Switch on Anime Mode and it speaks real Japanese with subtitles on screen.     Nine characters, or build your own   Start in seconds with nine hand-written personalities, each a fully scripted persona localized into all 8 languages: Anna the Playful Sibling, Alice the Witty Historian, Michael the Gaming Buddy, Amelia the Supportive Friend, Mei the Yandere Girlfriend, Rei the Calm Mentor, Iris the Tsundere Companion, Lyra the Creative Muse, and Marc the Stoic Coach. Or build your own from four pieces you choose: a premade Live2D (2D) or custom VRM (3D) avatar, a persona, a voice engine, and a cloned voice. Import any VRM model from VRoid Hub, booth.pm, or your own creations. It's less an app than an AI companion platform, and a VTuber maker on the side.     It speaks

short: An idle MMO that runs in a small card above your Windows taskbar. Pick a task and your character keeps working while you do other things, and for 12 hours after you close the game. 14 skills to level 120, clans of 50, 5 bosses. Every drop can be sold on the Steam Community Market. Free to play.
about: An idle MMO in the corner of your screen Lowbar Legends runs in a small card in the corner of your screen, above the Windows taskbar. Pick a task, like chopping yew logs or fighting bears, and your character keeps doing it until you pick something else. Close the game and the task keeps going for 12 hours (24 with the Premium Charter). When you come back, you see what you got.         What you do    14 skills, up to level 120.  Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing and Foraging gather. Carpentry, Smithing, Cooking, Alchemy and Enchanting turn that into planks, bars, food, potions and runes. Melee, Ranged, Magic and Slaying fight. Excavation digs, and the dig sites change every week.   Running a task around the clock, level 99 takes about two months and level 120 about a year.    5 bosses , from level 60 to 116. Fight them with any combat style, collect each boss's weapon set and upgrade it to +10. Upgrades never fail.    6 achievement diaries  with 5 tiers each. Finished tiers give chests, a pet and lasting perks such as longer offline time.   Mastery Capes at 120, a pet for every skill, a collection log and leaderboards.         Every drop trades on Steam There is no auction house in the game. To sell something, send it to your Steam inventory with the Caravan and list it on the Steam Community Market like any other Steam item. Resources, gear, Vault Keys, chests, dyes, skins and pets can all be sold. What you buy on the Market comes back into the game through Arrivals. Mastery Capes and diary rewards stay on your account. As with every Market sale, part of the price goes to Steam and part to the game. Rare drops keep the name of the player who found them.         Clans A clan holds up to 50 players. Train the same skill as a clanmate and you both get a little more xp. Give materials to clan projects, like the Clan Wharf or the Hunting Grounds, and every member keeps the bonus once it is built. Each week the clan fills the Sunken Vault raid together, and it pays out on Sunday. Upgrading the clan hall gives every member up to 12% more xp. Free to play There are no ads and no energy bars. The Shop sells two optional items:    Premium Charter:  24 hours of offline progress instead of 12, up to 2 backup tasks that take over when your task runs out of materials, 3 Caravan slots instead of 1, Enchanting and Alchemy past level 30, and your name in gold on boards, clan lists and chat.    Patron:  looks only, for players who want to support the game. Pick one of 6 chat name colors, and get a ◆ mark and a Patron tag next to your name.  Both are items. Use one yourself or sell it on the Steam Community Market, so a player who never pays can still buy a Charter from another player with what they have sold. There is no PvP. Xp, items and upgrades never depend on luck; the only random drops are pets, chests and cosmetics.  Report bugs from the ? menu in the game window.

about: Welcome to Meow Palace!    A cozy, laid-back game that blends idle play, bonding, and cultural discovery. Slip into the paws of a stray kitty who’s wandered into the Forbidden City. With the help of palace cats, you’ll learn new tricks, collect treasures, unlock stories, and experience the whimsical life of a royal feline.             The story begins with a stray cat that accidentally wanders into the palace—but its destiny is up to you.     Create A Cat : Customize everything from name, fur pattern, pupils, ear shapes, and tails to craft your perfect palace companion.                 Go from “Stray Cat” to “Imperial Guardian” through effortless idle gameplay.     Idle Training : Learn up to 15 skills, including Imperial Cuisine, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Peking Opera, and Fishing with the instruction of veteran palace cats. Higher skills = better yields.               Craft Fashion & Furniture : Use collected materials and blueprints to make outfits and home décor for your cat.     Palace Encyclopedia : Every crafted item, animal encounter, and discovered treasure is collected into your growing compendium.              Feeling stressed at work? Tired of studying? Let your palace cat stay on your desktop.     Desktop Pet Mode : Your cat lives directly on your Windows desktop, quietly gathering resources while you’re busy. Tap it when you take a break and enjoy simple, soothing interactions.                   Encounter NPC cats based on actual residents of the Forbidden City, and explore the Palace Museum through their eyes.     The Palace Cat Family : Meet Aobai the dignified, Sheriff the clever, and Mantou the gentle—each being the inspiration of NPC cats in the game!            Four Seasons of the Forbidden City : Unlock classic locations, such as Hall of Supreme Harmony, Palace of Heavenly Purity, Palace of Compassion and Tranquility, and more. Write an email, finish a chapter, grind through a spreadsheet: crack by crack, little birds hatch and settle in among your keys.         No grinding, no stress, nothing to lose. Just a small friend that shows up when you do. What's inside    Hatch a flock of desk birds  that hop from key to key, sit a while, and react when you pet them.            Pomodoro tomatoes  to slice your day into focused sessions. Every session you finish drops a ripe tomato into your jar.            A CRT typing race : a retro mini-game to warm up your fingers and chase your best time.            Magic words  hidden in everyday typing. Type the right one and something small and delightful happens.            Hand-drawn everything , animated frame by frame by one person.   Made to sit quietly beside your work Type 'n Hatch is not a game you sit down to play. It is a game that keeps you company while you do everything else. Leave it in the corner, glance over when you need a breather, and watch your flock grow as the days go by.         Made by a solo developer at the Thinking Pixel.

name: Touhou: Your Reimu
lang: English, Japanese, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*
short: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.
about: Bring Reimu to your desktop   Your Reimu  is a desktop companion who shares your daily life with Hakurei Reimu from Touhou Project.  Leave Reimu in a corner of your screen while you work. Now and then she'll mutter to herself, greet you when you come back after a while, and tell you something different on special days.  Indifferent and blunt, but she stays by your side in her own way.  Click, lift, and move her around  Click Reimu and she'll react with a line of dialogue. Keep clicking over and over and she might grumble that you're being a pain.  Press and hold to lift Reimu up and move her wherever you like. She sways and tilts as she follows your cursor, then settles naturally wherever you let go.  You can also resize her with the mouse wheel, and her position and size are kept even after you restart the app.  Leave your to-dos with Reimu  Put a simple TODO list on your desktop to jot down what you need to get done.  Add tasks, check off the ones you've finished, or delete the ones you don't need. Reimu reacts each time you knock one out, and when you clear the whole list she'll acknowledge your effort, saying you've earned a little rest today.  “Got one done. Not bad, actually.”  Timers and alarms too  When you need to focus, start a timer right away or enter any duration you like. You can also set an alarm to go off at a specific time.  One minute before the timer ends, Reimu lets you know it's time to wrap up, and when time's up she nudges you herself along with an alert sound.  “I'll watch the clock. You just do your thing.”  The TODO list and alarm widgets can each be opened separately and moved wherever you like.  Never in the way, but always there  Areas without Reimu or a widget stay clickable, so she won't get in the way of other programs. Talk to her only when you feel like it, or open the TODO list and alarm when you need them.  Less of a secretary who does the work for you, more of a housemate who watches from the side and chimes in now and then.  Spend your days with Reimu—blunt, allergic to hassle, and fond of a good donation. [hr][/hr]  月影工房 Work No. 7    This game is a fan-made derivative work of Touhou Project by Team Shanghai Alice. It is not an official Touhou Project product.

about: 60 adorable fish species, 117 appearances           Aquarium Days includes guppies, danios, corydoras, bettas, discus, arowanas, koi, freshwater stingrays, and more. Some species come in different colors and patterns, for a total of 117 appearances.  Different species move in their own ways: some swim in schools, some stay near the surface, and others spend most of their time near the bottom. New fish are automatically recorded in the catalog, making it easy to see which species and appearances you still need to collect.   18 aquarium scenes           Choose from 18 aquarium scenes featuring aquatic plants, driftwood, caves, stone steps, underwater ruins, and other layouts.  Select a scene to change the entire look of an aquarium.   Upgrade equipment and unlock more aquariums           Upgrade equipment to increase aquarium capacity, earn coins for longer while offline, and unlock more aquariums. Each aquarium can have its own scene and selection of fish.   Keep your aquarium on the desktop           You can keep the game in a small aquarium window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.   Relax and watch, with no daily upkeep           Aquarium Days focuses on collecting and watching fish, without complicated aquarium chores. Feed your fish when you feel like it, and they will be fine even if you do not open the game for a few days.

about: Hi, I'm Tatiana, a solo developer behind Tulip Season. This game blends my favorite genres: farming sim and incremental games. I hope I made the incremental part satisfying and not disturbing the overall wholesomeness.                 Features   🌷  Beauty quantified.  Wilhelmina has one ambition - to make her field the most beautiful in the kingdom. Beauty of the field is the number that you grow in the game. All other elements contribute to this main focus.  🌷  Villagers with personality.  You neighbours are nice folks. They love to chat and participate in your field life. Their small requests guide you through various field upgrades, and their gifts bump up the beauty score.  🌷  Idle mode built in.  Designed from the start to work both as an active game and a hands-off idle  experience.  🌷  Gradual complexity.  A progression tree introduces new tulip types, tools, and mechanics step by step, keeping things cozy.         Plant bulbs, water them, and help them flourish into colourful tulips. Every day the tulips are scored for beauty. The more you score, the sooner you level up.         Discover new tulip types as your farm develops. Breed flowers to reveal fresh colour mixes and rare double blooms that add depth and beauty to your designs.                  Check in to plan your next pattern, or step away and let your tulips grow on their own. Your field keeps evolving even while you’re not playing.         Chat with your neighbours who stop by your farm and learn their stories. Completing small favours for them  brings decoration rewards and a few friendly smiles along the way.

name: Abracademia Demo
lang: English
short: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.
about: Abracademia is  a cozy witch idle life-sim  that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play.                        Abracademia  runs quietly while you study , watch videos, or play other games.  Your wizard lives their life at your pace. You can micromanage every little detail or let magic handle the rest.    Move Abracademia around the screen, adjust the game speed, or pause anytime you want.                     Your journey begins after you receive your letter from Abracademia School.   Create your own wizard , shaping their appearance, their background, and even their magic wand.    Define a magical profile that reflects who you are,  shaping your strengths, your weaknesses,  and the kind of magic you naturally lean toward.    Finally comes the moment every mage waits for… the  test that determines your Coven.   Will you join the creative Waltzpurgis, the secretive Medusalem, or the outgoing Feynyx?  Each of the five  Covens offers its own unique content and spells.                        Abracademia takes place over five school years, leading up to your wizard’s graduation.  Your character will  attend classes every day, join activities , and, of course, take exams.  While some activities are mandatory, you decide how your wizard spends the rest of each day.    Do you want to be a studious scholar? A gossip queen? A pompous noble, quietly plotting in the shadows?  Or maybe someone who solemnly swears they’re up to no good.     In Abracademia, any path is possible.                       Classes, events, and quests earn you experience in magical disciplines, letting you unlock new spells.   With over 300 spells across 20 disciplines  (Home Magic, Transformative Arts, Umbra…), you can shape your wizard in your own way.  Use magic to get boosts, ace exams, make friends (or enemies), and experiment with different spell combinations to discover crazy synergies.    And if you like a little friendly competition, check the Students Leaderboard!                         Your wizard isn’t alone.  Other students can be rivals, allies… or perhaps something more.   You can study together, attend parties, compete in events, and build relationships that shape your school life.    As your friendships grow, you’ll unlock special quests, and if things go well, you might even end up with someone special in the epilogue!                   When classes are over,  you can dive into quests  and explore the Fabric of Worlds, a place where magical realities meet.  Choose to be a friendly neighborhood wizard, helping wherever you can, or dive into the intrigues of the Magical World and see where they take you!    Quests will reward you with unique items, but they will also test your spell mastery, your friends’ help, and careful stamina management.    Don’t worry, there’s always more than one way to solve a problem.

about: Welcome to Dinosaurium — your personal prehistoric sanctuary built from sun-warmed cliffs, mossy ferns, and ancient riverbeds. Discover, care for, and grow over 500 unique dinosaur species across nine richly themed prehistoric habitats.               With a single click, your dinosaurs leave the habitat and roam freely across your real desktop — characterful, transparent companions striding over your windows while you work, study, or browse. They never get in the way: clicks pass right through them, and a tap of ESC sends them home. Your living collection, alive on your screen.               Build the ultimate dinosaur library across nine themed packs — Theropods, Tyrants, Raptors, Sauropods, Ceratopsians, Armored, Marine Reptiles, Pterosaurs, and more. Each species is assigned one of seven rarity tiers — from Common to Ancient. Unlock stunning visual variants: Normal, Painted, Golden, and Rainbow. From tiny feathered hunters to towering long-necks, complete your collection one fossil at a time.               Witness prehistory come alive in real time. Eggs hatch into tiny hatchlings that wobble through your habitat. Watch them grow into magnificent adults — raptors darting through the ferns, sauropods stretching their necks to the canopy, tyrants striding across the plains. Release them for instant rewards, or keep them in your habitat for steady passive income. Every decision shapes your strategy.               Your prehistoric park keeps thriving in the background while you work, study, or browse the web. The automatic feeding system keeps your dinosaurs happy and fed; when you return, gathered rewards are waiting. No pressure, no timers — just progress at your own pace.               Choose from cliffs, ferns, volcanoes, decorations, and day-night lighting cycles. Customize multiple habitats exactly the way you want. Build a lush jungle valley, a sun-baked desert ridge, or a misty marine cove — this is your sanctuary, your rules.               Climb the rankings by total collection value or by the number of unique species you've discovered. See how your prehistoric park measures up against dinosaur keepers worldwide.

name: AFK - Army For Keyboard
lang: English, Turkish, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Polish
short: Your army keeps fighting inside the taskbar while you get on with your day. AFK is an idle RPG built as a fake desktop OS: drag windows, forge gear across ten rarity tiers, climb an endless tower, and settle scores in asynchronous PvP the server replays back to you.
about: AN IDLE RPG THAT RUNS LIKE AN OPERATING SYSTEM  AFK does not ask for your attention. It gives you a desktop. Your battle plays out live in a 990x76 strip inside the taskbar while you keep windows open, compare gear and plan the next build. Click the strip and the fight goes fullscreen. Close it and your army keeps going.  BUILD AN ARMY, NOT AN APM SCORE  Nine heroes, three on the field. Weapons, off-hands and elements are class-locked, so a party is a decision rather than a slot machine. Skill trees, rune allocations and prestige nodes stack into a build you can actually read.  YOU WRITE THE LOOT RULES  In an idle game loot is a stream, not a sequence of events. Instead of turning hundreds of overnight drops into hundreds of decisions, you write the rules once: ask me about legendaries, send runes to the cube, melt the rest. The pipeline enforces them and only the exceptions reach you. The decision queue holds at most fifty items and never touches your bag.  LOOT YOU DECIDE ON  Ten rarity tiers from Bit to Yotta. Implicit lines, affixes, enhancement from +0 to +25 with real downgrade risk, sockets, and runes that carry three candidate stats. The roll happens when you socket them, not when they drop.  THE CUBE  Turn runes into gems and gems back into runes. Every enhancement shows you its true success chance before you commit anything.  FIVE ACTS, FOUR DIFFICULTIES, ONE ENDLESS TOWER  Normal, Nightmare, Hell and Torment, each one unlocked by clearing the last. A stage map that mutates weekly, a tower with no ceiling, and timed Boss Rush races with a real reward ladder and a leaderboard.  ASYNCHRONOUS PVP THAT REPLAYS  Send your army to the arena. The server re-simulates the fight with the same deterministic engine your client runs, then hands you the replay. No lag, no waiting for an opponent, no arguments about what happened.  CLANS AND CHAT  A clan headquarters with members, contributions, a shared development tree, announcements and applications. Channels, direct messages and mentions.  SOUND WITH NO SAMPLES  Every effect and the background music are synthesised in code from waveform functions - no audio files ship with the game. Effects and music have separate volume controls.  PLAYS IN TWELVE LANGUAGES  Full interface in English, Turkish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
short: Dark fantasy idle auto battler: three worlds, 21 biomes, 630 stages and 63 bosses. A red-hooded archer holds the road against an endless horde while you hatch pets, farm boss gear, pick perks and ascend. Leave it on a second monitor or sit down and min-max.
about: How a run plays  A red-hooded archer with a silver moon bow holds a road the horde never stops pouring down. She fights on her own; what she becomes is up to you.     Every kill pays.  Gold buys upgrades, level-ups give perks, bosses drop eggs and gear.     Hit a wall? Ascend.  Trade the run for relics that boost everything for good, keep your pets and gear, and go farther next time.     She never stops shooting.  Leave the game on a second monitor, or sit down and chase the next boss. It works either way.     Close the game and she keeps fighting.  A reward is waiting when you come back.          Nine powers that change the fight  The Arsenal is the expensive stuff: venom, fire and frost, a mark on the toughest enemy, orbiting souls, chain lightning, arrow volleys, explosions and hail. Stack them and a quiet road turns into a storm.         Every level-up offers one of three perks: pierce more enemies, hit harder, heal off the damage you deal. Pick them yourself, or set a priority and let auto-pick handle it. The Stats screen shows where every point of power comes from and which of your tricks is doing the damage.  Three worlds, 21 biomes, 630 stages  The first world takes you through meadow, swamp, volcano, ice, ruins, desert and the shadow lands. Each land looks, sounds and fights differently: some monsters poison you, some heal their friends, some come in swarms, and some get back up after you've killed them.        63 bosses that fight back  A boss waits every ten stages, and each has moves you can read and answer: wind-ups to break with a hit or a freeze, shields, summoned guards, curses. Between bosses the road throws in a treasure chest that runs if you're slow, an elite with a fat reward, or a timed trial.        Hatch pets, hunt gear     48 pets.  Bosses drop eggs. Hatch them and take three companions along: each one attacks on its own and brings a skill you can fire yourself or leave on auto. Pets from the same family form bonds with extra bonuses.     84 pieces of gear in 14 sets.  Wear two or four from one set and you get something fun: permanent poison, a freezing wind, a second life, a star that falls on the toughest enemy.     Duplicates are good news.  They level up what you already own. Save three gear-and-pet builds and swap between them in one click.                 Beat the Eclipse Sovereign and the Rift opens  Stage 210 is not the end. The Rift is a second world: seven new lands, 21 new bosses, monsters that reflect your arrows or split in two, and pets and gear sets you can only find there. The Moon Devourer waits at stage 420. Beat it and the road leads on to the Moon.        Then the road climbs to the Moon  Past the Moon Devourer lies a third world: stages 421 to 630 across seven Moon lands, 21 more bosses with four moves each, and The Moon itself waiting at the end. Moon bosses drop their own egg with eight new pets, plus three new gear sets: Dustwalker, Selenite and Moonsworn. Past stage 630, endless mode keeps going with a new mutation every 30 stages.        Shatter the Moon  Beat The Moon and you can shatter it in the Great Rebirth: a new cycle from stage 1, Moon Shards for every stage you pushed past 630, and optional trials like Blood Moon for more. Shards buy four Moonbows that change how you shoot: a fan of arrows, an eclipse where every arrow crits, a tide that pushes the horde back, and moonbeams that strike the whole field. Eternal talents stay with you through every Rebirth.        Always something to come back to    Offline progress, with gold, experience and levels waiting when you return.    Three Ascend Paths, Hunter, Warden and Fortune, each ending in a capstone power, plus star nodes with no cap.    Auto-buy, auto-hatch and auto-pick once you've earned them, and game speed up to x4.    100 achievements and eight Steam leaderboards.          Good to know    Full controller support. Runs on Steam Deck.    Screen shake and flashes can be turned off, and a Minimal effects mode stops ev

about: MERGE SLIMES. HOLD BACK THE SWARM. The pen is filling with larvae, and your slimes attack automatically from outside the fence. Summon random slimes, drag them into position, and merge two of the same grade to create a stronger one. A modest defense line soon becomes a screen-filling battle against a relentless swarm. As grades rise, new attack styles become available—from single shots, piercing rounds, and spread fire to flames, lasers, explosions, and rocket barrages. Every merge can change the resulting type, so adapt your formation as it grows. name: Endless Snake
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Arabic, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: Snake starts simple. Then the Journey changes the rules. Play 100 challenges with portals, puzzle gardens and increasingly wild combinations. Unlock modes, snake skins, themes and more, and discover what waits around the next turn.
about: You know Snake. See where it can go. Follow a Journey of 100 challenges that mix arcade action with thoughtful puzzles. Paint the board, deliver parcels through portals, push crates into place and slide through Snake Golf courses. New rules gradually combine: fruit moves, your snake grows and shrinks, and hollow body rings become shortcuts. Stage checkpoints save your progress. Keep playing to unlock more modes, skins, themes, backgrounds, trails and music.    Relax in Endless. Master Strategist and Two-Body if You Can.    Endless Snake  starts with the snake you already know: eat apples, grow longer, and do not crash into yourself. Endless lets you keep it calm, settle into the rhythm, and play a clean one-handed run.  But if you think you have snake figured out, the harder modes are waiting.  In  Strategist , you plan your route before you move. A good plan feels brilliant. A greedy plan can trap you before the snake even starts. It turns snake into a tactical puzzle where every committed turn matters.  In  Two-Body , you control two snakes at once. One board, two bodies, one rising multiplier, and twice as many ways to ruin a perfect run. It is still snake, but now your focus has to survive on both sides of the board.   Pick Your Kind of Pressure      Endless  is the chill mode. No strict timer, no build pressure - just you, the board, and one more apple.     Classic  keeps the rules clean for pure high-score runs.     Strategist  turns routing into planning, timing, and commitment.     Two-Body  challenges your coordination by making you manage two snakes at the same time.     Journey Roguelite  adds upgrades, boss fights, build choices, and long-term progression.     Challenges  bring sharper goals through Time Attack, Daily, Weekly, Pure Score, and Boss Rush.     Score With Skill   Apples are more than points. Chain them for combo multipliers, cut close to danger for risk rewards, and use 15 apple types like magnet, slow, ghost, mystery, bombs, shrink effects, and score bursts to change how a run plays.  A casual run can stay smooth and simple. A serious run becomes a test of timing, routing, planning, and nerve.   Runs That Keep Changing   Journey Roguelite lets your snake grow in more ways than length. Pick upgrades, build around what you find, and adapt when a boss breaks your usual route.  The stricter modes are there when you want to prove something. Pure Score removes upgrades. Time Attack gives you 60 seconds. Daily and Weekly runs put everyone on the same seed. Boss Rush skips the warm-up and goes straight to the fights.  There are 10 bosses, unlockable skins and themes, replays, leaderboards, and 100 achievements, from easy first steps to goals that ask for real mastery.   One Hand. One More Run.   Steer with arrow keys or D-pad. Boost with one button.  Relax in Endless. Master Strategist. Survive Two-Body. Then try one more run.  In the next update: Curve Arena  Two buttons each. One shared screen. In this local party mode for 2–6 players, your snake moves forward continuously as you steer smooth curves, leave a trail and squeeze through short gaps. Avoid every trail, including your own, and outlast your friends. Earn points for each opponent you survive and race to the match target.  Play on one PC with a shared keyboard, controllers or a mix of both. Choose your keys, speed and points to win. Curve Arena will be available from Free Play and Together, outside Journey, with Classic and Modern graphics. Local multiplayer only.

name: Spiriki: Tiny Island Demo
lang: English
short: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!
about: Spiriki: Tiny Island is a  cozy incremental game where you transform a forgotten island into a peaceful sanctuary.    In demo, discover a tiny version of your island : decorate with a curated selection of items and have fun with the spirits!                     Care for three baby spirits with light virtual-pet gameplay. Lift them, pet them, and give them little treats!  In return, they’ll share elemental essences, a magic energy that will be of good use to bring the island back to life.        Don’t stress about management  or disappointing them if you’re too busy: they are content with you just being here!     On your island, some even tinier spirits might float peacefully around your furniture. Spirikis are ticklish, so if you see one, pet them too! You will get a little reward for giving them attention.                 Open your grimoire and summon cozy furniture, ornaments and curious items  to build your own perfect haven.    Enjoy an  easy to handle decoration system : choose an item, rotate it as you wish, and place it on your island! No worries, you can always move it later, and if you change your mind, with a simple click of the mouse, sell it!     Unlock more than +120 items!  At the start of the game, you grimoire is incomplete and missing some pages. Embellish your island, grow your island level harmony and discover new items collections.                 With hand-drawn  2D animations and stylized 3D environment s, we offer a soft ambient experience, perfect as an interactive wallpaper while you do other things.    Need to focus on something but don't want to do this alone?  Play in desktop mode!  The three spirits will continue to enjoy their lives on the bottom of your screen.              An original setting to discover:  through the environment, the description of each item and a light narration.     An enjoyable decoration system:  place, rotate, move again, and disable the grid snap for a flowing placement.     Change the island's weather  at any time; choose between five moods: dawn, day, rainy, dusk, and night.     Play at your own pace : growing your island takes time, with no possible failures.             We are Loan, Solenn and Tris from Pas Croyable Production :  an indie game collective focused on short productions made in small team  . Above all, we're looking to create tiny, accessible and impactful games, always  inspired by childlike wonder ! For Spiriki: Tiny Island, Mael joined us as the sound designer of the project.

about: Working With Montabi  is a desktop companion where curious Montabi visit your space and keep you company through your days. Every time you press a key, your avatar presses theirs too, reacting to your activity as you work and browse. Give visiting Montabi a little pet and watch them enjoy their time in your space.           Productivity with Company   Whether you're working, studying, gaming, or browsing, Montabi is there to keep you company with built-in productivity tools to help you stay on track. Stay organized with a to-do list, jot down notes with the memo, and manage your work sessions with a Pomodoro timer. Along the way, your avatar will offer gentle words of affirmation, encouragement, and little reminders to help you keep going.           Meet Curious Montabi Visitors   Look who came to visit! Curious Montabi may wander into your space when you place something they like. Some are easy to attract, while others need a little extra effort. Let them play, give them a gentle pet, and they might leave you a gift before they go. Keep typing to speed up their visits and see who comes next!           Discover All Montabi!   Meet every Montabi, from everyday visitors and special companions to elusive Montabi that almost no one ever meets. Fill in their Montapedia entries and collect their unique customization rewards to expand your customization collection.           Personalize Your Avatar & Space   Mix and match outfits, furniture, decorations, and accessories to create a space that feels uniquely yours. Whether you’re feeling cozy, playful, relaxed, or just want to try something new, make your little world your own.                     Collectible Montabi Discovery  — Experiment by placing different items to discover a variety of collectible Montabi.     Fun & Productive  — Turn your desktop into a fun little space with Montabi. Enjoy their company while using productive tools to keep your day on track.     A Free Experience Without Microtransactions  — Enjoy the full Working With Montabi experience for free. No microtransaction walls, no locked gameplay, and no pay to win mechanics.     Starting Small, Updating Occasionally  — We’re starting small with a limited amount of content and features. We plan to update the game occasionally with new content and features while continuing to listen to our community and improve the experience over time.     No Marketplace Scams!  — Enjoy a cozy desktop companion without worrying about marketplace scams, bots, or other activities commonly found in similar games. If you’re looking to make money by collecting and selling things in this game, this probably isn’t the game for you.     DLC to Support Development  — So, how do we keep maintaining and updating the game? We offer optional DLC, starting with  Donation and Supporter Packs , for players who love Working With Montabi and want to support our development. The game itself will always remain free and purchasing DLC is completely optional.

about: NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) is part productivity tool and part virtual buddy, featuring a helpful digital companion that lives on your desktop and transforms lonely grinds into cozy work sessions.        Niche Operators            Say hello to your new virtual buddy! To-Do Lists    Pomodoro and Timers    Screenshots    Stopwatch and Alarms    Blocklist and Focus Mode    Chill Out mode (for when you don't want to worry about having your windows stolen)    Cross-computer syncing (via Steam)          A Little Spice            You won’t get away with slacking on your Operator’s watch: Lily has been known to give her input on ALL of your activities. Comments on your activities (little raccoon, big personality)    Hidden minigame(s)    Shimeji and Clippy inspired, but better! (actual functionality!)  About the Studio  Glossbird was founded in 2022 with the mission of creating games that make us better. name: Deskpot
lang: English, Dutch
short: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!
about: Deskpot  is a miniature idle-farming simulator that accompanies you on your desktop! No infinite fields of crops. One potted plant at a time. Each time you press a key, a drop of water falls on your plant pot. You can place it wherever you like on your screen, and watch your plants grow as you click, type, and mash keys.  Grow and research plants  Unlock new plants as you progress through the game! If you harvest a plant enough times, you gain information about that plant in your Almanac. Each plant is different. Unlock cosmetics  Unlock different plant pots, faces and accessories through different requirements like 'amount of water drops created', 'amount of high quality plants harvested', 'amount of Almanac entries completed', and more! You can completely decide what your pot looks like. If you want a regular terracotta, faceless pot, you can even unequip the face.            Upgrade your knowledge  Deskpot has  60 different plants , spread out over  five plant types :    Flowers    Vegetables    Fruit    Mushrooms    Foliage    Each plant type has its own upgrades you can buy on the ' Upgrades ' tab. Some raise the base price of a plant type, others make a plant type grow faster, or raise the odds of a multi-harvest.  There is also base upgrades, that affect all plants, or the entire experience. Your picture, your pace Choose from over 450 pictures, including paintings, nature, travel and cozy illustrations. Set your puzzle anywhere from 9 to 10,000 pieces, with optional rotation. Relax in Zen, pause when you need to, and return to your saved puzzle. You can use the usual puzzle aids and smaller piece counts while collecting album pages.      Make room for your own memories Turn your own photos into puzzles and choose their framing. Save favorites, revisit finished pictures in your Gallery, and keep your imported pictures together in a personal photo book. A comfortable place to puzzle Sort pieces into trays, arrange them by color or shape, and focus on the edges when you want a starting point. Zoom in or consult the reference picture. Play with a mouse, controller or touch, and adjust text size, motion and sound.      A picture to build together Invite friends to a private Steam room for 2–4 players and work on the same puzzle. Choose Zen for a relaxed session or Speed for a timed challenge. Online co-op requires Steam and an internet connection. A puzzle corner on your Windows desktop Desktop companion mode places puzzle pieces over your Windows desktop. Move and resize the puzzle frame, spread loose pieces and connected groups around your screen, and click through empty space to other apps. Floating controls let you hide the pieces, adjust their visibility, bring out more from the supply or return to the normal puzzle. Your arrangement is saved. A different rhythm when you want it Try a Daily puzzle, explore art in Through the Ages, or chase a personal best in Speed with Steam leaderboards. The solo league offers timed races against simulated rivals whose pace is based on your previous results. These are optional ways to play; an unhurried puzzle is always there when you want one.

name: Pixel Kitten Desktop
lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese**
short: A cozy pixel-art desktop pet for work, study, and relaxation. Raise a kitten or build a growing cat colony! Breed cats, uncover hidden genes, trace family trees, and collect 43 coat variants. Care for your cats, decorate your desktop, dress them up, and enjoy a little pixel companionship every day.
about: PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP is a cozy, relaxing pixel-art desktop pet game.  Keep a single kitten to quietly keep you company while you work, study or daydream, or build a lively cat colony where cats meet, pair up and have kittens, and follow the family tree as different coats and hidden genes pass down from one generation to the next.   A pixel kitten on your desktop: company while you work and study   Every kitten has its own hunger, thirst, energy, mood, cleanliness, health and affection. It decides what to do next based on how it feels: strolling across your screen, curling up for a nap, stretching, meowing, or letting you know what it needs with a little emote bubble.  You can feed it, give it water, play with it, brush it and give it gentle pets, put it to bed, or give it medicine when it's unwell. As your time together grows, it slowly grows from a tiny kitten into a companion that's always there on your desktop.   Cat colony: a whole family living on your desktop   Start with two founder kittens and watch them live together and grow up.  Once they're grown, you can choose partners for your cats yourself or let them pair up freely. After a pregnancy, the mother cat gives birth to one or two kittens by her side, and a new family begins.  Every cat has its own hidden genes. Kittens inherit some traits from their father and some from their mother, and certain coats can even skip a generation before showing up again. The family tree shows how every cat is related to its parents, so you can trace your whole family line generation by generation.  You can also adopt unrelated newcomers to bring fresh genes into the family. All the cats in a colony share one inventory and one wallet, and use the beds, toys and auto feeders you place on your desktop together.   Keep it relaxed, or take on a breeding challenge   Choose stress-free casual play, or go for breeding with clear goals.    Casual mode: raise and breed cats freely with no goals. When a cat's health drops to 0 it only gets sick, and with good care it will recover.    Easy mode: complete a 5-step breeding route set by your founders' genes, and breed a kitten with a coat neither parent has.    Medium mode: complete 14 challenge goals, including breeding a third generation, revealing a hidden trait and discovering 5 different genetic phenomena.    Hard mode: collect all 43 cat coats through breeding.    Take good care of every member of the family. In a challenge, if any cat's health drops to 0, the challenge is lost.   Collect, dress up and desktop life   There are 43 cat coats to discover, across four rarity tiers: N, R, SR and SSR. Every coat you find is recorded in your collection for good, waiting for you to complete it.  The shop offers food, bowls, beds, toys, auto feeders and more. Furniture you buy can be placed right on your desktop for the whole cat family to use.  You can also dress your cats in 22 wearable accessories, unlock 50 achievements, and use the built-in Lo-Fi music player to add a calm, cozy mood to your work, study and time together.  Whether you want one quiet kitten to keep you company or a pixel cat family that keeps growing, they'll live and grow on your desktop and share your everyday moments with you.   Features     Cozy pixel-art desktop pet    One kitten or a multi-cat colony    Breeding with hidden genes and a family tree    Casual mode and three breeding challenges    43 cat coats to collect    Steam Cloud saves    English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese

name: Doodlefolk
lang: English
short: Bring a little company to your Windows desktop. Meet procedural doodles with distinct personalities, watch friendships and skills grow, and give your doodles props and activities while you work or unwind. Customize their world with your own mods or ones from Steam Workshop.
about: A little life on your desktop  Doodlefolk turns your Windows desktop into a small world of curious characters. Your Doodles walk, jump, climb, grapple, ride windows, and react to your cursor while you work or unwind. Give them somewhere to sit, something to do, and a little room to surprise you.    Meet a cast with personality  Shape your Doodles with six personality traits, presets, likes, moods, and preferences they learn over time. Friendships, rivalries, romance, clubs, and families give each cast its own stories. Optional settings let you include babies and aging. Watch characters practise 14 skills, then explore their diaries, dreams, history, local sticker collections, and newspaper.    Customize names, colours, bodies, hats, and personalities. Keep multiple named casts and organize creations in your local Library, so you can return to a familiar group or start something new.    Make room for pets and play  Adopt dogs, cats, parrots, rabbits, and hamsters. Care for their needs, build bonds, teach tricks, groom them, and try different clothes. Furnish their surroundings with beds, seats, food, gardens, ponds, pools, vehicles, campfires, and lights.    There is plenty to get involved in: football, basketball, baseball, tennis, badminton, races, talent shows, skipping rope, trampolines, cursor games, sparring, fishing, gardening, local jobs, earned coins, school, forts, and festivals. Weather and seasons add variety to your little world. Fictional TVs, projectors, consoles, phones, and sketch computers provide built-in activities and content.    Doodlefolk includes cartoon fighting without blood or gore. Fighting and care settings are adjustable, and optional settings allow non-graphic permanent death and memorials.    Fit your routine  Use the Focus Timer, tasks, breaks, and reminders alongside your desktop companions. Capture local photos and short video clips (2–30 seconds, MP4 or GIF) in the Album. A short first-time setup, a first-day checklist, and hints help you find your way around.    Calm mode, colourblind team labels, quiet and sound controls, graphics settings, and battery-saving options let you tailor the experience. Gaming Pause steps aside automatically when a fullscreen game or app is in front; you can switch it to manual. Local position restoration is also opt-in.    Create something of your own  DoodleKit supports local, data-only JSON and SVG packs for objects, hats, characters, names, jokes, songs, town moods, festivals, starting scenarios, and simple behaviours. Build on the application's existing actions and use the validator to check your pack. Share your packs, or download other players', through Steam Workshop. Packs are activated after restarting Doodlefolk.    Help shape Early Access  Doodlefolk is growing with its community. When Early Access begins, we'd love your help finding issues, sharing ideas, and telling us what makes your desktop companions fun to spend time with. Your feedback will help guide fixes and priorities.    Community feedback will help guide development during Early Access. We plan to build on the desktop experience already available, and our priorities may change as players share what they enjoy and what needs work. See the Early Access answers above for our current plans and estimated timeline.    Online visits between towns are planned but not available yet, and there is no multiplayer. Optional connected extras include Steam Workshop, Steam Cloud, Twitch chat, and weekly Steam community goals.    Doodlefolk is made to keep running on your desktop, so Steam counts all the time it is open as playtime, including while it's paused or hidden. That includes the 2 hours of playtime in Steam's refund policy; if you're still deciding, quit from the tray icon when you aren't using it.

name: Pixel Pegz
lang: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
short: Cozy puzzle and arcade games for a little window that stays on top while you work, your Steam Deck, or the couch with a controller. Untangle arrows, pour sand, sort hex stacks or squish jelly, one bite-sized round at a time.
about: Puzzle and arcade games for the corner of your screen   Pixel Pegz is a cozy collection of puzzle and arcade games that goes where you go. Keep it in a corner of your screen while you work, curl up with it on your Steam Deck, or play on the couch with a controller. Untangle a picture made of arrows, pour colored sand, sort stacks of hex tiles, fling squishy jelly into a pile, or split a grid into rooms, one bite-sized round at a time.           At your desk, on Steam Deck or on the couch   Shrink Pixel Pegz into the mini window, a little window that stays on top of your other windows, and keep a puzzle going beside your work, your stream or your show. Click away and the games with a clock or falling pieces pause on the spot; the rest simply wait for your next move. Every game sits in a little list and picks up right where you left it, and a run in progress comes along when you switch sizes (on PC).  On Steam Deck, the menus and boards are big and readable, made for its screen. Real-time games pause when you open the Steam menu or put your Deck to sleep, every game keeps your run, and Steam Cloud keeps your progress in step with your PC.  On the couch, every game, menu and shop plays with a controller, and a second player can join on the same screen. Mouse and keyboard work everywhere too.   The games    Puzzles      Arrows:  untangle a picture drawn in arrows. Tap one and it glides off the way it points, as long as nothing's in its way.     Square Up:  fit pieces onto the board to fill rows and columns, and watch them clear.     Hex Stacks:  set stacks of colored hex tiles on the board. Matching colors slide together, and a tall enough stack of one color clears in a pop.     Floor Plan:  split the grid into rooms, each number telling you how many cells its room has. Every puzzle has exactly one answer.     Dot to Dot:  draw one path that fills the whole grid, passing the numbered dots in order. Every puzzle has exactly one answer.     And more:  slide blocks out of Gridlock, match shapes in Shape Swap, set off merging chains in Tile Cascade, paint mazes in Grid Roller and guess five-letter words in Guesswork.     Arcade      Sandfall:  drop blocks of colored sand that crumble and pour as they land. Fill a band of one color from wall to wall and it washes away.     Jelly:  fling wobbly number blobs into the pile. Two of a number that touch squish together into the next one up.     Chip Away:  aim and fire a stream of balls at the numbered blocks before they reach the floor, picking up upgrades along the way.     Peg Pop:  time your drop and watch the ball bounce down through the pegs. Hit enough gold pegs to clear the level, with lightning, portals and multiball to help.     Sneaky Sneks:  slither around a big arena eating glowing food, and grow into the biggest baddest snek there.     And a few old favorites  for a quick round, on your own or with a friend.           Journeys, Easy modes and puzzles with no clock   Many of the games have a  Journey : a path of levels, each one the same for every player. Miss a level and it simply plays again. The level you've reached never goes backwards. The Journeys in Dot to Dot, Floor Plan, Gridlock and Grid Roller have no clock and no move limit, so you can take all the time you like.  Every game also has Easy, Medium and Hard, and Easy is gentle: small, friendly pieces that always fit in Square Up, slow and relaxed sand in Sandfall, and bots in Sneaky Sneks that mostly mind their own business. Stuck? In some games you can spend a few coins on a hint, or take your last move back.  Leave whenever you like. Every game keeps your run, so you can pick up right where you left off.           The Daily Challenge   The Daily Challenge deals a short run of games once a day, the same for everyone in the world. Play them with your coffee, keep your streak going, and see how your day compares with everyone else's.           Palettes and looks   Every game you play earns coins. Spend them on color p

name: RuneClick
lang: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
short: A tiny pixel adventurer lives on your desktop and levels up while you work, study or play. Your real typing, clicks and controller presses train 23 skills: chop, mine, fish, cook, fight dragons and chase level 99. Always on top, never steals focus.
about: What is RuneClick?   RuneClick is an RPG that lives on your desktop and levels up while you use your computer. A pixel art adventurer sits on top of your taskbar and reacts to your real keyboard, mouse and controller. Type an email, he chops a tree. Click through a spreadsheet, he mines ore. Walk away and he waits for you. No autoplay, no offline gains. Every level is earned, one keystroke at a time.           The Grind is Real   23 skills, and every one feeds another. Woodcutting fuels Firemaking, Fletching and Construction. Mining supplies the forge. Fishing and Farming stock the kitchen, Herblore turns herbs into potions, and Runecraft makes the runes you cast. Hunt creatures for hides and feathers, train with a coach, pick pockets, build furniture and bury bones at your own altar. Level cap is 99 per skill, and XP keeps counting after that.           Fight Back   Pick a style and go. Melee, with four stances that shape which stats you train. Ranged, with bows and crossbows firing arrows and bolts you fletched yourself. Magic, with 24 spells powered by runes you crafted. The combat triangle matters, so bring the right style to the right fight.  46 enemies, from chickens to dragons to the Abyssal Lord himself. Bosses change phases and weaknesses mid-fight. Slayer masters hand out tasks and unlock monsters that need the right gear to beat. The best loot waits at the top: the full Dragon armor set, the materials for Elder weapons, and six tiny boss pets.           Gear Up   Smith armor across six metal tiers from Bronze to Rune, then chase Black, Granite and Dragon from the monsters that carry them. Craft ten sets of leather and hide for Ranged, with a buckler in the off hand. Stitch robes for Magic. Forge tools that gather faster, cut gems into jewelry with passive bonuses, and cook food and brew potions that give you an edge. Four gear presets swap you between skilling, melee, ranged and magic in one click.           New in 3.3: Dragons, Superiors and Journals   Blue, Red and Black Dragons join the Green Dragon, and every dragon now breathes fire. An Anti-dragon Shield or an antifire potion guards you against the breath. Then take on the King Black Dragon. Slayer gets four new beasts, and twelve Slayer monsters have a rare superior version that can drop an Imbued Heart or a battlestaff. Six journals with four tiers each pay out in antique lamps and lasting perks. Magic fills in six combat spells from level 47 to 70. Spellcraft, which enchants your jewelry and bolts and turns spare loot into gold, learns four astral spells. And robes and hides now add accuracy.           Every Level Counts   Hit 99 and the fireworks go off. A collection log tracks 500+ items to find, 95 achievements mark the milestones, and 26 Steam leaderboards show how you stack up against everyone else putting in the hours.           It Lives on Your Desktop   RuneClick isn't a window you switch to. It's a transparent overlay that sits on top of your taskbar while you work, browse or play other games. Click through it, drag it anywhere, scale it from 50% to 150%. It launches with Windows, saves automatically and never steals focus. It's a companion, not a distraction.           Mod Everything   Add new skills, items, and recipes with simple JSON files. Want full control? Write GDScript mods with access to every system in the game. Share your creations on Steam Workshop. A complete template mod with an example skill is included to get you started.   Features     Always-on-top desktop overlay with click-through transparency    23 interconnected skills with progression to 99 and beyond    Keyboard, mouse and controller input all count    Full combat: 3 styles, 4 melee stances, 24 spells, 46 enemies, 6 bosses and Slayer tasks    Metal, leather and cloth gear ladders, with a drop-only Dragon tier    19 pets to collect    A collection log with 500+ items    Three characters per PC    A real economy with a General Store and anti-arbitrage pricing    26 Steam le

name: PlankTap
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.
about: A Jellyfish on Your Desktop   Fire up the game, and a jellyfish floats onto your desktop.  No annoying windows, no taskbar icon. It just quietly floats there. Once you've positioned and sized it with your mouse, let it be — like a tiny piece of the ocean has landed on your desktop.  You can drag it anywhere — a corner, the edge of your screen. Scroll to resize — as small as nearly invisible, or as big as, well, impressively big.  ---   You Type, It Earns   It knows when you're typing (mouse clicks count too).  Type slowly and it sways gently. Type faster and it starts swaying excitedly, its expression changing along the way. Oh, and every keystroke also earns you a coin. Every little bit counts!          ---   There's a Stock Market Under the Sea   What to do with all those coins? Trade stocks!  Seven virtual stocks with underwater names. Their prices shift every few minutes, influenced by all kinds of factors — so remember to glance at the tips your little jellyfish brings you from time to time!  Check the chart, check your portfolio, then buy and sell. You can sneak a peek between tasks, then get right back to work. A quick dip during your workday is all you need to get that done.  ---   Rumors Pop Up on Their Own   Sometimes a bubble pops up above Jelly's head.  "Rumor has it the thermal vent region has been unstable lately." "Coral growth seems to have accelerated noticeably." All kinds of underwater gossip, appearing at random — some bullish, some bearish.  The rumor won't affect prices immediately though — there's a short delay. Rumors need time to brew, and you need time to act and get positioned early.          ---   Dress Up Your Jellyfish   Coins can also go toward something else: the skin shop (or maybe trading stocks is really just a means to buy more skins).  We've prepared a whole wardrobe of weird and wonderful skins — seasons, desserts, starry sky, pearl, mushroom, volcano, diamond, robot, cyber, ancient.  Prices vary, but unlocking them all will take quite a stash of coins.  ---   Just Use It   PlankTap isn't some big production. It's just a little desktop companion.  Once it's open, you can go do your own thing. It just floats there beside you. It moves when you type, zones out when you're away. Earn a few coins, check the market, maybe switch a skin.  No daily tasks. No stamina system. Nothing you *have* to do. It's just there.  Just being cute. That's it.          ---   Key Features   - 🐙 A cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop — transparent window, no pop-ups, no distractions  - ⌨️ Typing drives its movements — the faster you type, the more excited it gets, and it earns coins too  - 📈 Underwater stock market — seven virtual stocks with logical price movements, experience virtual trading  - 💬 Random rumors — bubbles pop up, hinting at where the market might go  - 🎨 Fifteen skins — unlock with in-game coins, no microtransactions required!  - 🖥️ Multi-monitor support — the jellyfish can roam freely across displays  - 🌐 Four languages — Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese
