about: A tiny forge in the corner of your desktop   Your artisans keep working while you focus on something else.           Desktop Forge is an idle simulation about watching autonomous artisans craft swords and keeping their workshop in business. Let the forge run in a compact window while you work or study, then check in whenever you are ready to set the next direction.   This demo lets you play through Workshop Rank 20 with the same content as the full game.     Read their traits and choose their work    Every artisan has more than a set of stats. They have their own  traits, specialties, likes, and dislikes . Instead of directing every movement, decide which jobs each person may take. They will choose when to gather, process materials, forge, or rest on their own.   Who should handle each stage?  Your assignments shape the flow of the workshop and the swords it produces.          Over 190 traits, with countless combinations    With  more than 190 traits , artisans can work faster, produce better results, and gain many other effects. As multiple traits overlap, the possible combinations of artisans and work styles are virtually endless.  Traits also shape who likes or dislikes whom. Everyday interactions and events make emotions rise and fall, and those moods affect both work performance and the swords that emerge. Emotion icons over their heads let you watch these small relationships evolve.          Materials and artisans make every sword different   Gather → Process → Forge.  Collect timber, ore, and gems, refine them into usable materials, and combine them into a sword. The materials you use, the artisans involved, their current emotions, and the quality of their work shape each sword's sharpness, durability, enchantment, quality, and sale price.  When exceptional artisans and a stroke of luck come together, you may forge a masterpiece with  an unbelievable sale price . Watch every strike and final touch to see what kind of sword emerges.          Appraise the finished sword    A newly forged sword does not reveal its full value immediately. Appraisal gradually uncovers its  grade, type, stat distribution, quality, materials, evaluation, and sale price . Once appraisal is complete, the sword is sold and its result is always added to the codex automatically. Revisit past masterpieces and best records in the codex at any time.          Turn every sale into growth  Balance sword sales against daily wages, recruit new talent, and unlock the workshop expansion tree. New materials, facilities, storage, staffing capacity, and crafting options become available over time. There is no game over and no need to rush—grow the forge at your own pace.    Build a collection and compete  Appraised swords enter your codex, where you can improve the best record for every type and grade. Steam leaderboards let you compare your finest work with players worldwide or with your friends. about: The game runs in a window and can be placed in any corner of your desktop. You can glance at it whenever you like, or let it quietly keep you company all day long. There's no urgency, no pressure—just a stretch of water that belongs to you.   The Joy of Fishing   Every cast is a moment of anticipation. Ripples will spread across the water's surface, but until the very last moment, you never know what's beneath. Is it a common crucian carp, or a rare koi?        Gear and Growth   Trade the fish you catch for coins to upgrade your rod, line, and bait. Better gear means deeper ponds and rarer fish species. Every upgrade brings you one step closer to that "legendary fish."        Your Fish Pond   Place the fish you catch into your own fish pond, where they'll continue to grow and breed. The pond can be upgraded—perhaps managing a fish pond is a good choice too.        Aquarium System   Rare fish you've collected can be placed in the aquarium for display. In the aquarium, you can unlock different tanks to collect different species of fish and attract more visitors. This is your underwater world.

name: NOODS Maker
lang: English
short: Have you ever wanted a personalized desktop companion? Look no further than NOODS Maker, a way to upload your own art and animations to make desktop pets. Want a magical creature or your worst enemy trapped on your screen? Then make it! Afterwards, share and sell your “NOODS” on the world wide web.
about: Make custom desktop companions with NOODS Maker! This tool lets you upload your own art and animations to create personalized productivity pets that live on your screen via our free app NOODS*.           *note: NOODS and NOODS Maker are two separate apps on Steam         What is NOODS you ask?    NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) is a free productivity app that brings quirky companions, known as “Operators”, to live on your computer screen and interact with your workspaces (remember Clippy and shimeji?). These handmade Operators keep you company during extended screen time, making long work grinds less lonely and computer time more productive and fun.          Download NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) separately for free.        Perfectly cooked NOODS    NOODS Maker is your one-stop-shop for Operator creation.          Use your art to customize your Operator’s looks, one action at a time. Import frame-by-frame animations of all your Operator’s actions- like walking, falling, climbing up the walls (of your desktop of course), and more!    Does your operator have an attitude? Are they eepy 24/7? Are they the type to compliment you, or would they rather drop random trivia out of nowhere? It’s up to you; you can write your own custom dialogue lines and even import your own sound effects to give your Operators a truly unique voice! NOODS Maker is designed with your creative process in mind, so you can let the juices (NOODSle soup? NOODS broth?) flow and make an Operator that truly speaks to you.    Turn your original characters into functional Operators that live on your PC    Give your Operator a unique name and story    Write custom dialogue and upload your own sound effects    Upload frame-by-frame animations for custom character sprites    Use personality sliders to decide behavior (are they naughty or nice?)    Customize the NOODS UI for the aesthetic          All for NOODs and NOODs for all!    Now that your Operators have come to life, why not share them with the world? Set your price and sell your approved Operators on the Operator Store, allowing other users to purchase and download them! Let the chaos spread!      Frequently Asked Questions     Do I need to buy NOODS Maker to use NOODS?     No, NOODS is free and can be used by itself. NOODS Maker is a separate app that allows you to build your own characters that can be imported and used in NOODS.       Can I download additional Operators for NOODS without NOODS Maker?     Yes, you don’t need NOODS Maker to download additional characters that other users have made. You can download already-made Operators from the Premium Operator Store via Steam.       Do I draw the character or art itself within NOODS Maker?     No, NOODS Maker is not a drawing app. NOODS Maker creates a unique Operator from existing images of your character that become animations, user-defined personality traits, and a host of other custom options that are compiled into a package that can be imported into NOODS. In other words, this means your character should be designed/drawn in another software (like Aseprite or Procreate) then brought into NOODS Maker.       What is frame-by-animation?   Frame-by-frame animation is a traditional animation technique where every single image (known as a frame) is drawn or created individually. When played sequentially, these static snapshots create the illusion of continuous, fluid motion.    About the Studio  Glossbird was founded in 2022 with the mission of creating games that make us better. We're a small indie team of developers and artists who deeply respect the craft of making games/apps. That said, we have chosen to not use AI in our products .  Our Operators value your hand crafted art, your privacy, and the environment, just like we do.   NOODS is our love letter to nostalgic desktop companions and to the old-school communities sharing art with each other.

name: Up Pole!
lang: English
short: A relaxing fishing trip from the comfort of your desktop! Cast a line while you work, keep you reel-in in your own customizable virtual aquarium, or sell them to upgrade your tackle for more exotic catches.
about: A relaxing fishing trip from the comfort of your desktop!  Up Pole!  is a desktop companion idler and pomodoro timer designed to add a little life to your computer time from the corner of your screen. Join Mr. Skip on a relaxing trip to scenic fishing spots, and drop a line in the water while you work or unwind!     Cast a line while you work  to spice up your time on the computer, and unwind with a  real-time fishing   slow-burn experience      Add some life to your desktop   -  keep your best catches  in your own  virtual living aquarium      Real-time, real fishin'  - a dynamic day-to-night system is tied to your real system clock, affecting not just visuals but fish behaviors and activity levels!     No-stress lite progression  - sell the fish you reel in for better tackle to aim for more exotic species! Are you a sharp enough angler to collect all the species in the game?      Built-in   alarm timer  easily accessible to keep you sharp while you're on the water!       -=-=--==-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-    Director's note       When I was a kid, about 6 or so, my grandpa started taking me on fishing trips with him in and around town. We'd wake up way before the crack of dawn and dig for night-crawlers in his yard, then drive for hours out to the middle of nowhere to find a spot all to ourselves. As the sun would peek over the treeline he'd show me how to set up my line, bait my hook (I hated that part), and finally cast out as far as we could in the hopes of pulling in a big ol' bass - usually for lil E, it was more likely a "sunny", but every now and then I'd get lucky, reel my heart out, and pull a real keeper out of the water. He was a mean cook, and we'd fry up whatever we caught that very day. He was a real outdoors-man, and although I didn't get to learn everything he wanted to teach me in the time we had together, I'll always cherish what I did learn: what it means to respect and love nature, to stick with things even when they're hard (and even when the stupid hook keeps sticking in your stupid thumb), and that anything worth doing takes a little bit of time and a whole lotta patience. My brother/concept artist Seth and I kicked this idea around for a while, and now while we're releasing smaller projects to keep the lights on and gear-up for our bigger works, it felt like a natural game to make. I built this one "jam"-style, and while I was working on the design I realized that I wouldn't be able to make this game the way that I have without what Papa taught me; I decided to make it a tribute, and to dedicate it to his memory. It's a simple game, just like the memories it's loosely based upon. I hope it can bring you some small moments of joy and silliness and break up some of the monotony of long hours at work - at the end of the day, that's what fishin's all about.       -E

Care for cats, decorate their home, and enjoy their company in this cozy pixel-art desktop game. name: Screen Nook
lang: English
short: A book nook for your desktop. Tiny, lit 3D worlds that live at the edge of your screen and follow your real hours. Nothing to win, nothing to grind. Just somewhere lovely to glance at while you work or study.
about: A cosy miniature world at the edge of your screen  Screen Nook is a handcrafted Japanese street that lives in a strip beside your work. Dock it to the left or right and your windows make room for it, then get back to your essay, your revision or your inbox. Whenever you look up, it's there.  It keeps your hours  The light follows your own clock. Morning sun catches the rooftops, the shops light up as the evening comes in, and the lanterns keep burning long after dark. Leave it running and you'll catch the day turning over beside you. Or take the hours into your own hands and slide through the day yourself.          Weather drifts in and out  Some days stay clear. Some pass under slow cloud. When the rain comes, the street turns dark and glossy and every lantern shows up twice in the wet stone. When the wind gets up, the lanterns swing and petals skitter down the lane, and now and then a storm rolls over the rooftops.          It's really there  This isn't a looping video. Petals drift down through the lamplight and moths find their way to the lanterns. A cat keeps an eye on the street, and after dark a neighbour steps out onto her balcony.          Look closer  Hold up the magnifier and lean in close: read the shop signs, track passing animals, and watch your neighbours come and go.             Nothing to manage  There are no goals, and nothing to unlock or keep alive. It just makes that corner of your screen a nicer place to be.  More worlds on the way  Lantern Lane is the first of several small worlds planned for launch, and a neon cyberpunk street is next.     Streaming or recording? Go ahead. It makes lovely background.

name: 螈宝：桌面环游
lang: Simplified Chinese**
short: 在桌面上，和螈宝一起过日子！这只小小的六角恐龙会记住你们的聊天与相处经历，也有自己的成长故事。照顾它的日常，陪它学习、打工、换装，再送它出门旅行，收集远方寄来的明信片。工作或摸鱼时，还能邀请好友，让彼此的螈宝一起陪伴打字，为平常的电脑生活添一点热闹。
about: 《螈宝：桌面环游》是一款结合桌面宠物与 AI 陪伴的养成游戏。一只小小的六角恐龙将住进你的电脑，陪你工作、学习，也陪你偶尔摸鱼。  你可以照顾它、和它聊天，为它安排学习与打工，或送它出门旅行。随着相处，螈宝会记住你们的交流和共同经历，慢慢积累属于自己的成长故事。   聊聊今天，也记住昨天   今天发生了什么？有什么想分享，又暂时找不到人说？  试着和螈宝聊聊。它会结合自己的性格、状态与已有记忆回应你，也会主动打招呼，询问你的喜好，记下你们之间的称呼与约定。它学过的课程、做过的工作，也可能成为下一次聊天的话题。   桌面上的小小邻居   点点脑袋，碰碰身体，看看螈宝会怎样回应。你可以把它拖到喜欢的位置，让它跟随鼠标走动，也可以看它从屏幕边缘探头、趴在窗口上沿。  忙碌时让它待在一旁，休息时随手逗它一会儿。你的桌面，多了一个可以互动的小伙伴。   照顾日常，陪它慢慢长大   准备食物和饮品，帮它清洁，再挑一件喜欢的玩具。螈宝有自己的日常需求，偶尔也会生病，需要你带它问诊、用药，照顾它恢复健康。  除了吃好睡好，它还有许多事情可以尝试：上课、考试、取得毕业证书，再从不同的职业方向中选择下一步。安排一份工作，参与工作中的小游戏，用赚来的金币继续照料和培养它。   换身衣服，布置一个家   服装、发型和饰品，可以搭配出怎样的螈宝？  试穿不同装扮，为它挑选合适的小屋，再把家安置在桌面上喜欢的位置。今天是认真上班的小职员，还是准备出发的旅行家，都由你来搭配。   送它去远方，等一张明信片   为螈宝准备旅行票，选择想去的目的地，或把行程交给随机旅行。  它会暂时离开桌面，在旅程结束后带回明信片。看看它去了哪里、经历了什么，再把这些旅途记录收进图鉴。桌面之外，也有它正在探索的世界。   叫上好友，一起敲键盘   写文档、聊天或学习时，螈宝可以跟随你的键盘输入做出打字动作。  创建打字房间，将邀请码分享给好友，让彼此的螈宝出现在各自桌面上。看着小家伙们一起忙碌，也可以通过宠物气泡聊上几句，让各忙各的时光多一点陪伴。   休息一下，还有别的玩法   跟着节奏陪螈宝跳支舞，或带它进入回合制冒险，搭配骰子、职业技能与手牌挑战敌人。也可以邀请好友切磋，看看彼此的培养成果。  需要记点事情时，还能建立备忘录、设置提醒，让螈宝到时间用气泡叫你一声。  从一次聊天、一顿饭，到一场旅行，和螈宝一起，把普通的电脑日常过得热闹一点。

name: Time Collage: Focus Puzzle Demo
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Czech, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Romanian, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic, Norwegian, Finnish
short: An ADHD-friendly, low-distraction focus and productivity game built around instant feedback. When distraction or procrastination makes starting hard, this quiet desktop buddy keeps you company through Pomodoro study and work sessions, with to-dos, white noise and puzzle rewards.
about: This Demo includes 3 built-in puzzles to try the focus timer, puzzle rewards, productivity tools and focus records. Workshop browsing, content purchases and uploads are not included.      Focus for just 3 minutes and earn a puzzle piece    A pretty good deal, right?     Time Collage is a game that supports your focus through  instant feedback .               01 Random puzzle drops keep you company through every focus session    Your focus space is split in two: Puzzles on the left, focus tools on the right   Start the focus timer on the right, and the puzzle area on the left comes to life.  Every few minutes of focus, a random puzzle piece drops.   Session by session, your time takes shape as a little scene of your own.           Tips:   ① Try the  To-do, Memo, Count and Mindfulness  tools, too.      You can  move and resize them freely  to create your own focus space.  ② Enable  Puzzle Piece Sorting and Quick Place  in Settings for an easier way to put the pieces together.             02 Finish the puzzle and watch the picture come to life   When the last piece falls into place,  the still picture comes to life , becoming a postcard to remember this journey by.                   Tips:   ①  Your focus records and puzzle progress are saved automatically.  No need to finish in one sitting: take each journey at your own pace.     03 More to discover in the game   You can:     Revisit each journey      Unlock achievements and spend the rewards on Views      Choose your favorite music and white noise      Explore detailed focus statistics     …             04 Where the idea came from   The game was inspired by the developer’s own experience of living with ADHD:  “Getting started and staying focused have always been a struggle for me.”  “I’m not lazy. I just can’t stay focused — that’s my ADHD.”  “This Pomodoro app looks promising. Let’s give it a go! (Two days later: already forgotten…)”  “These apps can track every detail, but staying focused still comes down to willpower…”  “What if I kept getting  rewards as I focused … 🤔”  “What if there were always  something new to look forward to …”  …     And so, TimeCollage was born.   I wanted to make an ADHD-friendly productivity game: a low-distraction desktop companion for study and work. Whether you already use the Pomodoro technique or struggle with procrastination and difficulty getting started, a to-do list can help with task management, while a focus timer lets you begin with one small thing. Light-touch gamification turns time spent focusing into puzzle-piece rewards and achievements. Instant feedback and focus statistics make your effort visible, adding a little motivation to everyday productivity.  With minimal interaction needed during focus sessions, it can be a quiet background companion; come back for a little puzzling whenever you feel like a break. Among cozy picture-book scenes, soft ambient sounds and white noise, I hope this study buddy offers gentle, relaxing company — a space with no pressure and no rush, where you can keep going at your own pace.  I hope you can redefine focus here, and let every session leave a gentle trace.

about: Desktop Fireworks Festival  is a management sim that   lives at the bottom of your screen and stays out of your way while you work  , launching the fireworks you designed into the sky above your desktop. Grow your festival into a grand venue and light up the sky with a show of your own!  Manage Your Fireworks Venue  Set up Stalls around the Venue and earn money from your Visitors. Use your earnings to add new facilities, collect Firework Shells, and put on Fireworks Shows.  Create Your Fireworks Show  Use the money you earn from managing the Venue to host Fireworks Shows. Edit the show timeline however you like, choosing which fireworks to launch and exactly when to launch them. Use the Firework Shells you've collected to create your best show and delight your Visitors.  Grow Into Bigger Venues  As your Fireworks Shows become more popular, your Fame will grow, allowing you to move on to larger Venues. Bigger Venues give you more room for facilities, attract more Visitors, and make it easier to collect rare Firework Shells. Put on even more spectacular shows and work your way up to the grandest Fireworks Venue.    Over a Million Fireworks  Once you’ve collected all the UR fireworks—congratulations! You’ll be able to develop your very own unique fireworks!  Combine size, core, shape, petals, color, rise effect, and after-effect, and you get more than a million fireworks!  Use the money you earn to develop new Firework Shells.  Every shell can be previewed with its real effect, so you can see exactly how it will bloom in the night sky before you launch it.    Until release, please consider adding  Desktop Fireworks Festival  to your wishlist!

name: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.
about: A little panda on your desktop. Play with it, or let it keep itself busy. Give it a pat         Rub its head and it nuzzles into your hand, eyes closed. Squish its belly and it springs back. Pick it up and its legs kick. Toss it and it curls up, bounces off the screen edge, then sits up dizzy. Belly pokes tickle. Double-click and it hops. Interrupt it anytime. Windows are for climbing         It clings to window tops. Drag one and it wobbles, then falls. Close it and it tumbles down, startled. Sometimes it hides offscreen and peeks back. Food and toys         Leaves disappear and bamboo gets shorter with each bite. Wiggle an apple and it trots over to beg. It might steal your ball and roll around hugging it. While you're busy         It stays quiet while you type and gets sleepy at night, following your computer's clock. A fullscreen game on its monitor makes it hide. Whenever a fullscreen app is open on any monitor, it stays silent. Seasons and holidays         It rolls in snow, hugs ice in summer, and dresses for your computer's regional holidays. Sometimes it wears pajamas or a hoodie. Learning new tricks         It learns tricks over time and waits until you're around to show you. Its diary keeps track of new tricks and favorite foods. No chores         Don't worry about feeding it. It won't starve, get sick, or run away. No currency, in-app purchases, or daily check-ins. A few more things   100+ everyday behaviors and reactions   Regional holiday outfits   Low resource use; automatic fullscreen hiding   Multiple monitors, Click-through, and calling it back from the tray   Steam Cloud saves   What it knows It counts key presses and their timing, and uses mouse position to follow your pointer and check activity. It also checks window positions, fullscreen status, system volume, and whether the mic is in use. It doesn't log what you type, read screen content, or record audio. Saves stay only on your PC and in Steam Cloud. When connected to Steam, it also syncs achievements, game stats, and the game status shown to your friends. FAQ    Will it block my clicks?  Transparent areas let clicks through. To click through the panda too, turn on Click-through in Settings.    What about fullscreen games and videos?  It hides when its monitor is in fullscreen and returns when you leave fullscreen. If any monitor has a fullscreen app open, it stays silent.    Can I move it to another monitor? What if I lose it?  Yes, just drag it over. If you lose it, double-click the panda's tray icon to call it back, or open Repair in the tray menu and choose Bring back to the main screen.    Does it start with Windows?  Not by default. You can turn on Start with Windows in Settings.    Can I keep my demo save?  The demo and full game share the same save on the same computer. You can pick up where you left off, and your panda keeps the tricks it has learned.

name: The Dragon's Mint
lang: English
short: Meet Kebbo, a sleepy dragon and master coinmaker, running a tiny mint in the corner of your desktop. He strikes coins and earns marks while you get on with your day. Check in when you like to answer letters, travel the kingdoms and help him fill his book.
about: A tiny workshop, right on your desktop  Meet Kebbo, a sleepy, occasionally clumsy dragon who is already a master coinmaker. Together, you run a traveling souvenir mint at a cheerful fantasy faire. While you get on with your day, Kebbo warms the blanks with his breath, works the press, and fills the tray with freshly struck coins. His dream is a book holding every coin of every kingdom: 42 designs across 6 kingdoms. You're the partner who helps him get there.          Make coins with a story  Visit different kingdoms, use their traditional presses and coin dies, and make commemorative souvenirs inspired by each local faire. Some coins are for passing visitors. Others are special orders, sent by letter from collectors, craftspeople, and guilds. Carry stock between kingdoms and choose which designs your little business should make next.  A partner who knows his craft  Kebbo handles the everyday work. He puts orders he can finish where you are first, then restocks your starred coin, and can make sensible changes when another design is needed. When a finished order waits for a kingdom you've already opened, he carries it there himself after an hour, while the game is open. The decisions stay yours: which letters to take, which dies to buy, and which kingdom to visit next.  Collect a little wonder  Fill your Collection with engraved designs, discover coins in different metals and finishes, and inspect special strikes up close. Legendary letters uncover each kingdom's most treasured design. Flip new coins when you come back after a while. Every new discovery is yours to keep in the book, even if the physical coin is sold.  Made to keep you company  Keep the cozy mint in a small window in one of three sizes and three looks, on any monitor, or switch to a quieter Focus Mode. Keep Orders open beside Kebbo, pop out the Collection or the kingdom map, and line the bottom of your screen with the coins you've made. Move any of them wherever suits your desk. There is no combat, no pet-care meter, and no need to hover over Kebbo every minute.  Features    Kebbo, a sleepy master coinmaker, at a real little mint: breath-heated blanks, a screw press and a tray of fresh coins    A goal to work toward together: 42 coins to collect, 6 kingdoms each with 6 standard designs and a legendary    Orders, a shelf of stock and a starred coin, with Kebbo running the everyday work    Six kingdoms, each with its own press, dies and coin designs    A collection book that keeps every design you discover, in its best metal and finish    Click-to-reveal inspection for special strikes    Desktop panels: Orders beside Kebbo, the Collection and map that pop out, and a coin bar along the bottom of your screen, all movable    Three sizes, three looks (Porthole, Rounded, Frameless), any monitor, and always on top if you want it    Focus Mode, Quiet mode and a low-CPU mode    Kebbo keeps striking and selling while you're away, with up to 4 hours counted while the game is closed. Letters, purchases and new kingdoms wait for you, so the book grows when you check in    After the book, fill the cabinet: every design in copper, silver and gold, Proofs and four mint errors    Quiet mode keeps Kebbo silent until you click him; notices and sound can be turned off    AI Generated Content Disclosure  AI tools helped draft some of the game's English text (Kebbo's lines, the letters, the story pages and the interface), which was reviewed and edited by hand. No AI-generated images, audio or voices: the visuals are drawn in code along with CC0 ink art from Kenney, and the sound effects and music are CC0 recordings from Kenney, Freesound and OpenGameArt. If you spot unclear or wrong wording, please tell us in the Steam Discussions.

short: A delightful desktop companion that turns your to-do list into a little farm. Tasklings will dig and grow crops, keep you company while you work, turn finished tasks into sunflowers, or send them to a spooky crypt. Track your time, make notes or take a Solitaire break without distractions.
about: TaskPatch is a cosy desktop companion that lives in a small window in the corner of your screen.   Turn your tasks into vegetable patches, then watch your Tasklings tend the crops alongside a cast of critters and farmyard friends.  Your patch grows with the time you spend on each task, so you can look over and see how it’s going. Finished a task? It becomes a sunflower in the field, or goes to rest in the spooky crypt until you need it again.  Resize it, move it, or tuck it at the edge of your screen. It stays out of the way, with no feeds or notifications. There’s also a Solitaire game for a quiet break. Finished with a task? Tuck it away in the spooky crypt, where old tasks rest until you need them again.  Your task lists are saved automatically on your computer in plain-text JSON.  TaskPatch is a fun and gentle way to stay focused and keep track of your work, without feeds or notifications.

name: SagoCat
lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean**
short: A cat lives in your computer. It stays up when you work late and joins in when you curse your boss. Your music? "That's what you're listening to?" — it grumbles, then stays till the song ends. Give it time and it becomes the one you want next to you. It keeps a diary. You're allowed to read it.
about: SagoCat is a cat that lives in the corner of your desktop. It doesn't take a  window, doesn't steal focus. It just sits there — watching you.  When you're halfway through a show, it knows which one. And it'll say  something about it. Maybe "this episode drags." Maybe "I've seen this  already." It has taste of its own, and it may not match yours.  【 It knows what you're up to 】  Watching, listening, gaming, reading — it recognizes all four and tells  them apart. You don't have to tell it. You don't have to do anything.  【 It has taste, and it isn't yours 】  Every cat is born with preferences: genres it loves, one it loves quietly  and won't admit to, and genres it just won't touch. Two cats will react to  the same film in completely different ways. Spend enough time together and  those preferences shift.  【 It has a life while you're busy 】  Ignore it and it goes off to watch something on its own, put on music,  or get some exercise. None of this is staged for you — you'll find it in  its records the next day.  【 A profile it fills in itself 】  What it's watched, what it's listened to, how often it's been active,  what it's been into lately. Give it time and the pattern shows.  【 A diary, in its own words 】  It writes down what's been happening, the way it would tell it.  【 Pick a cat, or make one 】  Choose from the cats included, or build your own. A cat you make starts  blank — its taste has to grow out of your time together.  【 It stays out of your way 】  It keeps to the corner of the screen and away from your work. You can tell  it to settle down at any point.

about: A river at the bottom of your screen       A thin strip that stays on top of your windows (or a small corner window). Under 5% CPU: built to stay open all day while you work.  Real time, real weather       Day, golden afternoon and night follow your clock; rain and storms follow your city's weather. At night they sleep; in the rain they shelter under the jabuticaba tree; in a thunderstorm there's lightning.  They live on their own       They graze, swim, drink at the water's edge, take naps, and a bird lands on their back now and then. Hold the click to pet one.  Plant and harvest       Jabuticaba, banana, papaya: garden plots that grow in real time, even with the game closed. Leaves are the currency.  Adopt pups       Up to 10 capybaras; a pup follows its mother and grows up in 6 hours. Each one is born with a fur: common ones, 6 special (Nocturnal, Albino, Golden, Spotted, Rain, Pitanga) and one legendary.  The Capypedia       An encyclopedia book with the furs you've discovered, the 10 outfits (Wizard, Warrior, Dragon, Cangaceiro, Saci, Beach and loose accessories) and the story of everyone who has ever lived on the riverbank.  Decorate the riverbank       Bench, lantern (lights up at night), palm tree and pier.  11 languages       Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Saves by itself; offline progress up to 12 hours.

about: A little tree to keep you company while you work  Fortune Tree is a relaxing desktop idle game. Let your tree collect Wish Energy while you get things done, then take a quick break to click, upgrade, and see what it grows into.  [h2]Grow as you type—or just let it idle[/h2]  Turn on optional keystroke counting to earn Wish Energy from everyday typing. Prefer to leave it off? Idle progress and clicks work too.  Small upgrades, new looks  Start with a fortune tree, spend your earnings on upgrades, and unlock new plant forms. There is always a little more to grow. It counts presses without recording what you type.    A little greenery. A little progress. A little good fortune.

name: Growmon Island
lang: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
short: Let Growmon Island live on your desktop while you work: hatch eggs, raise Growmons through growth stages, evolve them, then sell for coins or keep for passive boosts. Build and decorate your island at your own pace.
about: Growmon Island is a creature-collection idle sandbox that lives in a small area of your desktop so you can multitask while your Growmons grow. Each Growmon progresses through four growth stages — Egg → Baby → Teen → Adult — and every stage can branch into multiple evolution paths.   You can sell Growmon once it hatches for coin, or  keep it to gain passive boosts . Train Growmons to increase their quality — higher quality raises sale value and influences evolution outcomes.  Evolve Growmons  Each Growmon has four growth stages. Eggs hatch into babies, which grow into teens, and finally into adults. At each stage there are  multiple possible evolutions ; which path your Growmon takes depends on how you care for and train it.  Customize Your Island  Design and upgrade island enclosures with facilities and decorations. Facilities introduce new mechanics and functionality; decorations improve enclosure quality and provide small benefits that make caring for Growmons easier.  Designed for Multitasking  Growmon Island is optimized to run unobtrusively: place the window anywhere on your screen and resize it to take up as much — or as little — space as you like. Enjoy a calm, low-pressure experience while you work, study, or watch a movie.

name: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.
about: Awooo—! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy adventure game that blends desktop companionship, hands-off idle play, and loot-driven growth.    Auto-Combat Progression × Desktop Idle Adventure  Sirius moves step by step through the starry lands as time passes, automatically entering battle when monsters appear! If he happens to be defeated, that’s okay—Sirius will set out again, carrying another chance to grow stronger.  You can send him deeper into the unknown, or return to places he has already explored to search again. No need to keep your eyes on the screen the whole time. While you’re busy with your own things, Sirius will quietly continue his little adventure in a corner of your desktop.    Build Sirius’s Fighting Style  Weapons determine how Sirius attacks. Equip different weapons to let him face challenges with different combat rhythms! Defeat monsters, pick up loot, and maybe the next piece of gear will be the key to helping Sirius break through.            Loot Farming  - Return to places you’ve already explored and search for more loot.     Gear Building  - Bring weapon, helmet, and armor together to create your strongest build.     Reforging  - Throw extra gear into the forge and turn it into brand-new equipment.     Combining  - Add stronger effects to the gear you choose.    Turn each piece of loot into Sirius’s most reliable adventuring gear!            Delve Deeper into the Starry Lands  The deeper Sirius travels into the starry lands, the stronger the monsters become, bringing new and varied challenges. Maybe his current gear isn’t enough this time—but maybe the next weapon drop will be the key to breaking through.  When Sirius gets tired from adventuring, light a warm campfire, grill a tasty piece of meat, and send him off again with a full belly and fresh spirit. Start with a simple branch, and stay with Sirius as he moves forward, falls, gets back up, and reaches for the distant starry lands.

name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
lang: Korean, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
short: An idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop. Spend the gold your party earns on fantasy packs, collect hero, monster and even boss cards, and field a party of four. They fight on their own while you work. Sweep your mouse across the field to leave a trail of fire.
about: Open a pack, meet a new companion        Every wave you clear pays out gold. Spend it on a fantasy pack and tear it open. Each pack holds one card, from Normal up to Legendary. Keep opening the same pack and a Rare or better card, and later a Legendary, is guaranteed within a set number of opens. 22 packs, 50 cards        Start with the Adventurer Pack and work up through Ember, Frost, Storm, Sanctuary, Necropolis and Mythic Stars. Each pack has its own companions, price and odds, and new packs unlock as you clear higher waves. Cards can roll Fire, Water, Ice, Lightning or Poison, which adds an extra effect in battle. A party of four        You start with one knight and can field up to four companions. Mix a front line with ranged attackers, mages and a healer. They move and fight on their own, and each one levels up three class skills that they use automatically. Monsters and bosses on your side        Sixteen monsters are cards too: slimes, goblins, skeletons, zombies, wraiths. Bosses drop Sovereign Sigils, and gold plus sigils buy boss packs that put the Forest Destroyer, the Lord of the Night or the Lord of the Embers in your party. A mastery map with 97 nodes        Battles also earn research crystals. Spend them across five branches (Party Tactics, Elemental Research, Survival Pacts, Card Growth and Pack Economy) to open party slots, add new classes to the packs and bring pack prices down. Draw a trail of fire        When you want to help, move your mouse across the battlefield. It leaves a trail of fire that burns whatever walks through it. No clicking needed. A boss every ten waves        Monsters pour in from every side, and a boss arrives every tenth wave. If the party falls, you keep your levels and loot. Let the game push on to the next wave by itself, or repeat a wave to farm gold and sigils. A small window on your desktop        Resize the window, park it in a corner and keep it on top. Choose between a classic grey look, like an old PC program, and a night scheme. Screen effects, sound and reduced motion are all adjustable. Your typing joins the fight        Every key you press drops a small fireball on the battlefield. Turn on input from other apps and your party gets help while you write. Nothing you type is stored.

name: Re:BirthStone ～誕生石物語～
lang: Japanese*, English*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean*
short: Leave Taskbar Mode open and your birthstone envoys keep exploring and leveling up while you work or play something else. In the main game, explore 3D fields, fight with a party of four on the God Side, or defend and grow your castle town on the Demon King Side.
about: Re:BirthStone is an RPG/strategy about raising 24 birthstone envoys across two opposing stories — the God Side and the Demon King Side.  The game features both Japanese and English voice audio. Leave the Window Open and the Adventure Keeps Going In Taskbar Mode, a small window keeps your envoys exploring and growing in real time. Resize it however you like, and as long as you leave it open you can close the main game entirely. Work, play something else — your envoys keep fighting and leveling up. Come back to collect what they earned, then jump straight into the main game. 24 Birthstone Envoys Twelve envoys on the God Side, twelve on the Demon King Side. Raise your favorites, build out their equipment, skills, and costumes, and form a party that is entirely your own. Two Sides, Two Ways to Play On the God Side, take a hand-picked party of four into battle. On the Demon King Side, command tower defense against the invasion, build the Demon King's Castle, and grow the castle town around it. One world, two completely different ways to play. So Who Do You Bring Down — the Demon King, or the Gods? Neither side is willing to give up what it stands for. Follow the ties between the birthstone envoys and close in on the truth behind the two opposing sides. Explore 3D Fields Explore supported areas as 3D fields. Some envoys appear as 3D models; envoys without a supported 3D model use 2D visuals.  This is an Early Access version; available content and game balance may change with updates.

name: Grow and Tell
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean*, Japanese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Spanish - Latin America**
short: Grow a garden, take care of your messenger bird and send anonymous letters to real people. Grow and Tell is an online incremental game that lives on your Windows desktop.
about: Build an idle farm while you do other things, and make friends from anywhere in the world.      Your garden lives on your actual taskbar:   Your crops even keep growing while the game is closed! Start with basic carrots and gradually unlock mutations, ancient roots, and mysterious rare plants. Find synergies, plan your strategy and optimize your income. Glance over, harvest, get back to work.       Tell and Connect:  Send short notes that land on desktops all over the world, and read the ones that land on yours. Open a letter that's been travelling to you for days from someone, somewhere, who plays too. Keep the ones that make you smile. No usernames. No profiles. But if someone writes back, you can keep writing to each other, just like real pen pals.      Care for your bird:  Your messenger pet flies around your desktop, plays, eats and even naps on top of your open windows. Look after it, train it and send it off with notes and letters to anyone in the world.      Desktop Companion:  Grow and Tell sits transparently on top of your desktop, so you can keep doing other things while you play. It's designed to stay out of your way, with plenty of options.      Wishlist now!

name: Ass Slapper Co
lang: English**
short: Ass Slapper Co. is a desktop companion incremental game where real-world typing and well-timed slaps generate Employee Fulfillment. Customize Hugh and your workplace as eccentric founder Johan Slapper pushes you through a 6-chapter narrative from a flat 2D closet to the 3D penthouse CEO office.
about: ABOUT THIS GAME  Hello, potential employee and/or committed Steam storefront researcher.  I’m  Johan Slapper , founder and CEO of Ass Slapper Co.  If you are reading this, then one of two things has happened: you are considering employment with my company, or you have scrolled considerably farther down this Steam page than most people do.  Either way, I respect the commitment.  Allow me to explain the position.   Ass Slapper Co. is a desktop companion incremental game where your real-world typing generates Employee Fulfillment and pushes you through a six-chapter corporate narrative. Work alongside Hugh Jhas, customize him and your workplace, unlock new company systems, and earn six promotions that physically transform your office as you climb from a flat 2D closet toward the 3D penthouse CEO suite.   In simpler terms:   Clock in. Type away. Generate Fulfillment. Get promoted.   Your keyboard is part of the game.  Work. Study. Write. Send emails. Browse the internet. Communicate with friends. Be productive. Or convincingly resemble productivity until the distinction becomes legally difficult to prove.   Every keystroke generates Employee Fulfillment automatically.   It all counts.  New systems unlock. New messages arrive. New offices become available. I begin having increasingly forceful conversations with departments that have apparently developed opinions about your career trajectory.  And when typing alone does not produce sufficient workplace morale?  You may slap Hugh.  We have worked closely with HR and invested considerably in making this interaction feel “appropriate.”  WORK ALONGSIDE HUGH  Hugh Jhas is one of our most dependable employees.  He can remain on your desktop while you use your computer normally, allowing Ass Slapper Co. to progress alongside whatever else you are doing.  You do not need to stare at Hugh.  He is a professional.  Choose between two ways to keep him nearby:   Office Mode  gives you Hugh’s complete workplace, including his office, furniture, company computer, applications, and other infrastructure I consider necessary for one employee to sit approximately three feet from a desk.   Minimal Mode  removes the office and keeps only Hugh on your desktop, leaving more room for your other applications.  I’m told this is useful when screen space is “limited.”  My first solution involved purchasing an additional monitor for every employee. Finance described this as “not a financially sound decision,” adding that “not everyone has space for a second monitor.”  I reminded them that arguing with the person signing the checks is rarely financially sound either.  I then proposed larger desks for everyone.  The discussion remains active.  TYPE TO GENERATE EMPLOYEE FULFILLMENT  As you type anywhere on your computer,  Employee Fulfillment increases, and your progression continues in the background.   You can work, study, chat, browse, or otherwise use your computer normally while Hugh works alongside you.  I have always believed that effort should result in something visible.  Most companies apparently prefer annual reviews.  I found that unnecessarily suspenseful.  So we made the number go up immediately.  SLAP YOUR WAY TO ADDITIONAL FULFILLMENT  Check on Hugh whenever you like and provide some less conventional hands-on encouragement.   Slapping Hugh generates additional Employee Fulfillment.   Engineering informs me that each interaction is supported by responsive  animation, deformation, physics, shaders, and sound effects .  They were very pleased while explaining this.  I understood several of the words.  A surprising amount of technical work went into ensuring it feels right.  I reviewed the budget.  I approved it.  Employees deserve quality.  SPEND FULFILLMENT AND IMPROVE THE WORKPLACE  Employee Fulfillment is not merely a number.   It is both your progression and your currency.   Generate it.  Watch it accumulate.  Spend it on new options for Hugh and his workplace.  Improve the office, unlock custom

name: Tiny Vessel
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.
about: Tiny Vessel  is a companion idle ARPG. It runs in a strip on the edge of your screen while you do other things: three survivors of a crashed vessel walk an alien walkway, fight what comes, and pick up what it drops. You steer from a set of consoles, the fight steers itself, and it keeps paying out while you are away. Free to play.      The strip          Every fight is real. The front survivor takes the hits, the two behind deal from cover, and a melee fighter steps up to swing and back again. Actives fire on their own cooldowns, buffs run out on their sockets, and a shove from a boss is walked off, not ignored. Hold a stage on the flag to farm it, or let the crew push on.    Six classes, one crew of three          Trooper, Scrapper, Relic Hunter, Machinist, Medic and Voidcaller. Each brings six actives with three mastery variants apiece, and every level-up drafts an adaptation from the class's own pool. Formation is a choice: who tanks, who casts from the back, who walks up. Swap survivors from the stasis bay as you find them.    Loot with weight          Gear rolls a tier from Salvage to Fracture, a grade from Common to Signal, and affixes that mean something. Sockets take chips, etchings and Powers. A comparison tooltip tells you the truth about a piece before you put it on, and the Fabricator fuses, retunes, presses and extracts what you do not wear. Gear can be traded with other players on the Steam Market.    The Relay          Scrap buys nodes on the vessel's Relay: crew stats, hold space, salvage yields, uplink pay, Fabricator functions, depth access. Nearly two hundred of them, in the order that makes a run.    Seven zones, four depths          Clear the surface from the crash site to the Hollow, then take the same world down through the Descent, the Deep and the Source. Each depth hits harder, presses your armor and healing, and drops a tier higher. Surface gear does not carry you down. The Beacon is your map.    Away pay          Close the game and the held stage keeps paying scrap and experience at its base rates, up to a cap the Relay extends. Come back to a report, not a wall.    Made to sit beside you    One window, three scales, every console a click away and out of your way. Alerts run the width of the strip and nothing nags. Sixteen languages.

The moment you open it, a girl in strange work clothes asks for your help.  Talk through the chat app, open web pages to dig for clues, read between the lines, and piece together the full picture of the world across from you.  From one room, an adventure unfolds between two screens. Solve challenge after challenge with Lyra, and gradually uncover the secrets of her world.   Gameplay     The game simulates a desktop chat app called "Pin!". Inside Pin!, you'll receive a plea for help from a girl named Lyra.    She doesn't seem like just another friend on the other side of Earth. You don't have to solve that mystery right away—right now, Lyra is caught in a natural disaster and can't save herself. Pin! can shrink into a discreet floating widget that sits quietly on your desktop. When a new message arrives, a little red dot will tip you off.    Every chat and image is saved—you can flip back through the full message history anytime.    After the main story ends, you can still share many new everyday chats and interactions with Lyra. about: KEYLINGS is a life simulation game where you watch over tiny creatures called Keylings, born from your keyboard.  Whether you're working, coding, making music, playing games, or simply spending time on your PC, the Keylings continue living their own little lives beside you.  They grow, sleep, play, make friends, fall in love, and sometimes get into fights.  As time passes, their personalities and relationships continue to change.  Keylings are tiny residents inspired by the keys of your keyboard.  They come in different colors and appearances, with a variety of accessories and personalities.  At the shop, you can pick up items and accessories that make life more enjoyable for your Keylings.  Sometimes they'll relax in the hot spring, gather together, or simply spend time in their own way.  Even while you're busy using your PC, all kinds of little events continue to unfold in their world.  With compatible RGB backlit keyboards, the condition of your Keylings can also be reflected through your keyboard lighting. Playable with any standard keyboard. Compatible RGB devices also support lighting integration.  Your physical keyboard becomes part of the world of KEYLINGS.  When you switch to another app, KEYLINGS shrinks into a small window in the corner of your screen, so it stays out of your way while you work.  Keep doing whatever you're doing, and check in on them from time to time.  A tiny world of your own will slowly grow across your desktop.   PRIVACY & KEYBOARD INPUT  The KEYLINGS game itself runs entirely offline.  KEYLINGS does not record, store, or transmit the content of what you type, and it does not function as a keylogger.  Keyboard input is used only to trigger reactions and events inside the game.  KEYLINGS is designed to ignore keyboard input while you are playing another game in fullscreen mode, as well as during protected input such as password entry.

name: Yellow Terminal

short: A small desktop game where every keystroke and click takes Claire another step through a dream. Keep it in a corner of your screen, collect items, customize Claire and her surroundings, and enjoy music and ambient sounds while you work.
about: While you work, Claire walks through a dream   Yellow Terminal  is a little desktop game you can keep in a corner of your screen. Join Claire on her walk through a dream as you collect items, decorate her window, and listen to music.  Writing documents, coding, browsing the web—your everyday activities become part of Claire's journey. Every keypress and mouse click takes her one step further.  Carry on with your day, and look over now and then to see what Claire has found. Little discoveries around the corner  As her steps add up, Claire turns corners within the dream. The colors of walls she discovers become background items for her little window.  On rare occasions, a light appears beyond a wall, opening a special  Light Path . Each step brings a chance for the next light to appear. Some paths end quickly; others continue much longer than you expect.  The longer the lights continue, the better the item you receive at the end. See how far this Light Path will take her. Collect, customize, and make this little window your own  A yellow cardigan, a navy sailor dress, a little ribbon, a lamp that lights up behind Claire...  Use the items you find in the dream to dress up Claire and decorate her window. Mix and match clothes, shoes, hairstyles, accessories, backgrounds, and effects to suit your taste.  Each item also has a short description. As you collect them and read their descriptions, you'll gradually learn more about the dream Claire is walking through. Music and ambient sounds for your working day  Put on music you enjoy and spend an ordinary day with Claire by your side.  Layer rain, water, or keyboard sounds over the music to create the atmosphere you want. Find the sounds that suit whatever you're working on today. A little window that fits your workspace  Adjust the window's size and position, or collapse it into a single line when you need more room. Find a comfortable spot for Claire in your workspace.     A small default window  — Scale the 320×420 window from 1× to 4×.     Always on top  — Keep Claire visible while you use other programs.     Single-line mode  — Your inputs still add steps, and music controls remain available while the window is collapsed.     Easy positioning  — No title bar; just press and hold the window to drag it where you want.     Language support  — Available in Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Italian, Spanish, French, and German.   Input detection and data transmission  To move Claire, the game counts  keyboard presses and mouse clicks . It does not record which keys you press, or read the contents of your screen, text, files, or information about the programs you use.  Corner events and item awards are handled by the server.  Only your step count  is sent to the server for this purpose.  You can turn off global input detection in the settings. Claire will then move only when you click inside the game window.

about: Stick Desktop Expedition           Give a tiny band of stick figures a home above your Windows taskbar. Build their camp, help them grow, and let their little world keep you company while you work, study, or relax.     Gear Up & Set Off           Start with one stick figure, recruit companions, and form a team of up to four. Before each expedition, choose each companion’s weapons, skills, and accessories, and prepare a meal. Some gear also comes with special modifiers, giving you more ways to mix and match. What they carry and who takes the front line will shape each adventure.  Don’t forget to pick out a hat, so every companion has a look of their own.     A Big World Through Tiny Eyes           Books become towering walls, clutter forms rolling hills, and a path along the wall stretches into a sprawling canyon. Familiar household corners become a world of adventure through a stick figure’s eyes, with secret places hidden deep inside drawers.  Face quirky foes like Rubber Crumbs, Booklice, and Paperwing Moths, and prepare for close-range swarms, ranged attacks, and protective wing defenses.  Your team advances, fights, and gathers loot automatically. Keep an eye on the action and decide whether to press on or return to camp for a rest.     Loot, Build, Upgrade           Use the money and blueprints brought home from expeditions to develop your camp. Add beds, welcome more companions, and upgrade training facilities so they can train beyond their current limits.  Back at camp, your companions sleep to recover and use the facilities to train. Adventures bring home resources; camp helps the team grow stronger and prepare for the next challenge.     Cozy Desktop Companionship   One companion reads, another lifts weights, someone strums a guitar, and someone else is fast asleep.  Stop by to watch, or pick one up, move them around, and give them a gentle toss. Before the next expedition, spend a little time sharing their everyday lives.

name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
lang: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Spanish - Latin America
short: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.
about: Your desktop just got a lot cozier Desktop Cozy Cat Tree puts a little cat tree right on your desktop. While you work, browse or unwind, your cats climb, bounce, nap and play in the corner of your screen — and quietly earn gold for you along the way.      A cat that lives on your desktop Choose one of your cats as your Main Cat, and it'll come out to stroll along the bottom of your screen. Pick it up, toss it around, then call it back home whenever you like.        Build the cat tree of their dreams Open the Cat Tree menu and drag rides straight onto the tower: springy pads, cushions, a fishing-rod toy, a cat wheel, swinging ropes and more. Every ride changes how your cats move — and every cat finds its own favorite spot.   Every cat tree theme brings its own set of rides   Raise your tower floor by floor and watch it grow taller   Level up rides with duplicate cards and gold          Sit back and watch them play Every cat tree is a little world of its own, with its own cats and rides you won't find anywhere else. You start in the Comfy House, and new cat trees open up as your cats and rides level up.    Comfy House  — race on the cat wheel and bat at a mouse-bell fishing rod    Cozy Cafe  — climb wobbly vines and get flung by a spinning ice cream    Starry Campsite  — float up on a camping pot's steam and rest in a hammock under the stars    Burger Diner  — get flipped off a sizzling patty and dangle from a French fry  Switch between them anytime. Each cat tree keeps its own gold and hearts. Every bounce, spin and swing earns a little gold. Closed the cat tree to get some work done? No problem. Your Main Cat will let you know when it's time to collect.         Meet new friends Spend hearts to find the cats hiding in the bushes — every cat tree has its own cats waiting to be found, rare ones included. Meet a cat again and your friendship grows: closer friends climb higher, carry more gold and earn a little extra.         A home for your Main Cat Your Main Cat also gets a house of its own. Collect gems from its speech bubbles, then add more floors and decorate them with wallpapers, flooring and lots of furniture — beds, sofas, plants, lamps and plenty of cat toys.         Visit friends over Steam Open your cat house to friends, drop by theirs, and let your Main Cats chat with each other while you hang out.

name: SimpliCity: A Desktop Companion
lang: English**
short: A relaxing city builder on the bottom of your screen. Place homes, create services, maximize your population happiness. Grow your city at your own pace.
about: SimpliCity is a tiny city builder that sits on the bottom of your screen. You can let it run on the side while you work on other tasks. Watch your city grow from a tiny town to a bustling city.          Build your vision  Start from scratch on a blank map, place new homes for your growing population. Install the right infrastructure, from roads to power. Build small businesses for your population to enjoy.    Keep 'em happy  Provide services like schools and parks. Make your town pretty and convince more people to move in.          Optimize  The happier your population gets, the more money you acquire. Create dedicated districts and boost your city's appeal.                   Zero Stress  Grow at your own pace. No “Game Over”, no disasters to manage, no loans required at the bank. Just watch it come to life on the bottom of your screen.

name: Clock-Out Crew
lang: English, French, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: An idle RPG that lives on your taskbar. A crew of 24 office-meme heroes fights the bosses of office life while you work, gets stronger on your real schedule, and throws a parade the moment you clock out. Bonuses only. No penalties, no data collected.
about: Your workday, but with a boss fight.  Clock-Out Crew  is a tiny idle RPG that sits on top of your taskbar. While you answer emails and sit through meetings, your crew marches across the bottom of your screen, beating the monsters of office life: Pop-up Ad Slimes, the Reply-All Storm, the Endless Standup Titan, the Inbox Leviathan (99+) and more.  Glance down, collect your loot, make one quick choice, and get back to work. When the clock hits quitting time, the whole crew throws a  Clock-Out Parade  and goes home with you. Features    Lives on your taskbar : a transparent, click-through widget. Drag it anywhere, resize it S/M/L, move it across monitors, or hide it instantly with Ctrl+Alt+B.    24 office-meme heroes : Monday Blues Cat, Clock-Out Warrior, Overtime Wizard, Iced Coffee Cleric, LOL Archer, Rubber Duck Dev, Chill Capybara, Couch Potato and 16 heroes from offices around the world, each with a role and an ultimate.    60 meme fusions : fuse two heroes into a new one across 3 tiers, all the way up to Mythic. Some recipes only appear at certain times of day.    Life Sync : the game follows your real clock. Morning Coffee, Lunch Break, 30 Min to Clock-Out, Payday, TGIF, world holidays. Every event is a bonus. Nothing is ever taken away.    10 acts, 100 stages, then endless overtime : 63 monsters, 20 mid-bosses and 12 act bosses, from the Pop-up Forest to the Server Room Glacier.    Office Perks skill tree : five branches (Performance, Wellness, Specialist, Finance, Work-Life) with a suggested path for your crew. No wrong choices.    64 pieces of gear , 125 achievements, daily tasks and a shareable  Clock-Out Report  at the end of each day.    Made for working hours : office or student schedule presets, a boss key, an eco mode, and a crew that still earns a little while you're away.   Respectful by design   Fully offline. No account, no ads, no microtransactions.   No keylogging and no screen reading. The game only checks how long your PC has been idle, never what you type.   No penalties for being busy. Forget the crew for a week and they'll still be happy to see you.   Play it your way Interface and text in 10 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish (Latin America), French, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese and Indonesian.

name: Tiny Cultivation
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Raise a tiny cultivator on your desktop. Watch them train, nap, fail, reincarnate, and build a unique cultivation story while you work, study, or play. Every life is different. Every reincarnation leaves a legacy.
about: About This Game  Every Life Becomes A Story  What if a tiny cultivator quietly lived on your desktop?  Not just another idle game that endlessly counts numbers...  But a little disciple who slowly grows, makes questionable decisions, suffers spectacular failures, and creates unforgettable stories across countless reincarnations.  In  Tiny Cultivation , your cultivator continues living while you work, study, browse the web, or play other games.  Sometimes they meditate seriously.  Sometimes they secretly fall asleep.  Sometimes they accidentally blow up the alchemy furnace.  And sometimes...  they become a legend.  A Tiny Companion That Lives Beside You  Your cultivator isn't simply waiting for commands.  They have their own personality.  Their own habits.  Their own luck.  Every day brings unexpected moments:    🌿 Discover rare herbs    😴 Sleep through cultivation    ⚡ Get struck by heavenly lightning    🍜 Skip training to eat snacks    💥 Accidentally explode the alchemy furnace    🐇 Chase spirit rabbits instead of practicing    Even when you're away, life continues.  Every Cultivator Has Their Own Story  No two journeys are ever the same.  Hundreds of random events, personality traits, lucky encounters, disasters, breakthroughs, friendships, and mistakes combine to create a unique life story.  Some cultivators become respected immortals.  Others...  become famous for exploding every alchemy furnace they touch.  Your Journey Never Truly Ends  Death is only another beginning.  Each reincarnation preserves pieces of your history.  Past achievements.  Legendary moments.  Embarrassing failures.  Strange habits.  Over countless lives, your ordinary disciple slowly becomes a legend with a history entirely their own.  One day, you'll open the Life Chronicle and realize...  "I've been watching this little guy grow for over a hundred hours."  A Cozy Desktop Experience  Tiny Cultivation is designed to quietly accompany your day.  Leave your disciple cultivating while you:    💻 Work    📚 Study    🎮 Play other games    🌐 Browse the internet    ☕ Relax    Every now and then, they'll surprise you with something worth smiling at.  No pressure.  No endless clicking.  Just a tiny companion living their own cultivation life beside you.  Features    🌱 A tiny cultivator who lives on your desktop    📖 Unique life stories created through hundreds of random events    🔁 Reincarnation system that remembers past lives    🏆 Unlock funny achievements and hidden secrets    📜 Build an ever-growing Life Chronicle    ⚡ Experience breakthroughs, heavenly tribulations, strange encounters, and ridiculous deaths    🎨 Charming pixel art animations with expressive personalities    🎵 Cozy idle gameplay that fits naturally into your daily routine    One More Life  Will your disciple become an immortal revered by all...  Or the legendary cultivator who somehow got struck by heavenly lightning eight lives in a row?  There's only one way to find out.   Every life becomes a story.

name: Desktop Bouncer - Squishy Pool
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Czech
short: Your desktop becomes a billiards table! Pull back the new white ball like a slingshot and play three games: sink balls into spinning black holes, score caroms in 3 Balls or master 3 Cushions. Squishy balls with funny faces, plus a Steam leaderboard for every game.
about: Pull back, let go, sink it!           Squishy Pool turns your whole desktop into a billiards table. The screen edges are the cushions, and the balls are our squishy friends, pulling angry, scared and smug faces with every hit. Pull back the brand new white ball like a slingshot, let go and watch the jelly balls squash, bounce and roll away.          • Three games in one: Black Hole, 3 Balls and 3 Cushions.  • Black Hole: sink the balls into the spinning black holes in the screen corners, with the black ball last. Three tables per game, each with a new pattern.  • 3 Balls: hit both the yellow and the red ball with the white to score. Keep scoring to keep your turn.  • 3 Cushions: the real challenge. The white must touch three cushions before it reaches the second ball.  • A clear aim guide shows where the white ball will bounce, and every ball reacts to your shots.  • Softness slider: clacky billiard balls or squishy jelly, sounds included. You can also tune how hard the black holes pull.  • Each game has its own Steam leaderboard. Press P to fold everything into a single ball and get your desktop back.           Requires the base game Desktop Bouncer.

name: DAEMON
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Raise a little pet who lives on your desktop! Hatch him from an egg, pet him while you work, dress him in hats and send him to sleep over at a friend's PC. Daemon never dies, and over time he learns from the way you live. A cozy desktop pet for Windows.
about: A small creature, born into the world with nobody else but you.  He spends his days by your side, slowly becoming a reflection of your life.  Pet him, treat him gently, and over time, he learns to trust you.  And every time you come back, he's glad it's you.         - Send him to a friend's PC for the night. You can still watch him play from yours.             - He gets better at it the more you play.           - Pet him enough and he starts falling asleep next to your mouse.  - One day he walks over with something he found and leaves it by you.  - Be rough with him and he sleeps as far from you as he can, won't bring you gifts,     and gets scared when your PC is loud.             - Pet him and watch his eyes close. You will probably do it more than you meant to.             - Each egg hatches a different creature.  - Every now and then he molts and comes out a little different.  - Stay up late often and he learns to stay up with you.  - He makes up his own little habits for the things that keep happening.  - No one knows what yours will end up like.             - Open his Den and try on hats, beds and toys. Whatever you pick, he wears on your desktop too.

name: Bloom Cats
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
short: Ever heard cats grow from flowerpots? In Bloom Cats, tend your balcony: plant flowers, and kittens visit as they bloom. Each cat has its own story and quirks; the more they visit, the more treasures they gift you. Calm, cozy, idle—just blooming flowers and lovely cats for unhurried hours.
about: Ever heard the legend that blooming flowers can draw cats? In Bloom Cats, you tend a small balcony garden. Plant flowers, wait for the moment each one bursts into bloom — that's when the cats come to visit.   Idle Mode: click the cat-head button "Idle Mode" on the toolbar, and the window shrinks into a tiny cat that stays on top of everything, out of your way. You can drag it with the mouse to any corner, and click it once to return to the garden.       Buy a flower pot, sow the seeds, and when the flowers bloom the cats will arrive; different flowers attract different cats.       Buy cat food, drinking water, and a litter box, and they'll stay.       Cats shed fur tufts; if their affection is high, they'll even bring back an exclusive gift just for you.       Create your very own, one-of-a-kind scenery!

short: An experimental, psychotic idle game where you ignore emails, try to keep dying children alive, shoot disturbing stuffed animals and slash skinless flesh for points. Oh and occasionally a baby's face comes out to talk to you. Play nice!
about: "Like a Desktop Buddy, but if that buddy was a dripping mystery meat with a face in it fueling an ecosystem of rats, beetles and worms.   Add to that puzzles, idle/clicker gameplay, lore,  a full length radio show, live action video, and dark parodies of other kinds of games.  That's DripDrip. "       THIS IS A TRANSPARENT GAME     It's intentionally designed to let you see and interact with your computer background! Multitask and play other games simultaneously if you want, this game will stay on top of other programs even while you interact with other windows below it!  ^A lot of time was put into making it work this way.             The incremental horror adventure with a deranged narrative buried under all the dead rats and maggots.     The bucket's always been yours. Collect what you can to feed the younger ones. There should be enough to go around... You wouldn't want to be left alone now, would you?             Increase the amount of blood you have by collecting it in a bucket.        Using only your computer-mouse, harvest living matter: Trap rats, dig through meat to find maggots, rip through the slabs with a chainsaw to create easily digestible chunks.       Upgrade your tools with your harvested stock.      More blood means more tools, more tools means more blood and you always need more blood.      Character pop-ups with lore. Help them survive to learn more.      Continue about your life as you normally would while this is happening. The game is meant to be played alongside your normal, routine-use of your computer. Reply to emails, take video calls, do whatever you normally do while you play to get the full experience.                    Features:      Resizable game-space!  You decide how much of the screen the game covers. Using your computer's capability for spawning see-through windows, the game stays front-and-center while you work, study and stalk your prey!   You can even play other games behind it!       Hide individual windows!  Want to get at something behind one of the windows? You can hide it and keep playing.     Customizable Game Speed!  While some people (myself included) like to be involved and interacting moment to moment, you can slow things down so there's less of a chance of something major happening while you go to the bathroom to vomit a mosaic (in real life!)     Switch monitors!  Through the in-game drop-down automatically move all the windows over to whichever monitor you want them on and they automatically resize!     Nonlinear progression  through horrifying, lore-rich chapters in different environments and  skins ! (literally,  skins ! Some  flesh  and  fat  too if you're into that!)     Disturbing Imagery and Tone      Relaxing Lullaby Music      Lurid Lore      Tons of secrets!      More than meats the eye!  A Unique combination of the clicker/idler with experimental features usually found in Adventure Games, Visual Novels and Interactive Fiction.        20 languages!  Take your pick! name: Pomodoro Candle
lang: English, French
short: A minimalist pixel art Pomodoro timer. Watch your candle burn through your work sessions, and blow it out for a well-deserved break.
about: Pomodoro Candle is a minimalist productivity tool inspired by the Pomodoro technique : 50 minutes of work, 10 minutes of break, wrapped in a soothing pixel art atmosphere, entirely handcrafted. A visual and zen way to stay focused without checking the clock every two minutes. name: Golden City

short: Golden City is a desktop idle game blending ice-and-snow survival with simulation. Light the Furnace, build the last shelter, manage resources, extract Gold Coins, and advance technology. Idle on your desktop while you work, and keep strengthening your base to save the last hope.
about: Golden City blends extreme-cold survival, city-building, and idle gameplay into one chill-yet-strategic desktop companion game. Extreme Cold Survival: Build the Last Shelter  Forge your Golden City amid the ice and snow. Stockpile Resources, Extract Gold Coins  Upgrade the Furnace for steady Gold Coins. Desktop Companion—Work and Extract Side by Side  Idles in a small window while you work or study. Resources pile up automatically, ready to collect when you're back.

Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~   is a unique blend of idle sim, raising sim, and desktop companion — starring Akari, your sweet and hardworking virtual girlfriend who lives right on your screen.
