lang: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Ukrainian, Czech, Japanese
short: ASHENSHIFT is a pixel-art RPG that lives on your desktop. Three heroes fight in a slim transparent window above the taskbar while you work. Talents, gear, the forge and a rule for every ability are yours to set. Enemies wind up in plain sight: break the cast or raise a shield.
about: An RPG that lives on your desktop ASHENSHIFT is a pixel-art RPG in a slim window above your taskbar. Three heroes push through undead, demon and goblin lands on their own while you work, browse or watch something. The decisions that matter stay with you: who joins the party, what they wear, and the rules that fire each ability. Your desktop is the battlefield Switch the expedition background off and the window turns transparent: heroes and enemies stand right on your wallpaper. Scale it from 75% to 200% with the pixels kept crisp, and pin it on top of other windows if you like. An economy frame-rate mode keeps the load low while the game runs in the background. Three heroes, your rules         Bran the Guardian takes the hits, Lissa the Ranger strikes from range, Eira the Mystic heals and casts. Every ability takes a rule: a target, conditions and an importance level. Heal whoever is lowest on health, or hold an ability until several enemies are close. Want to pick the moment yourself? Fire it manually. Build not holding up? Refund talent points and try another. Enemies wind up, then hit back         A dangerous move has a windup you can see coming: the Headless Bellringer raises his hammer, the Furnace Butcher readies Furnace Burst, the Drill Chieftain revs the drill. Deal enough damage during the windup and the move breaks, leaving the enemy stunned. The General of Another's Funeral raises soldiers from the ground, the Skeleton Mage calls up the dead, elites hide behind shields: undead, demons and goblins each have their own habits. Loot worth checking         Enemies drop gear of different rarities: compare the properties and hand each piece to the hero who needs it most. The forge covers enhancement, polishing and reforging properties, plus shards and stones. A reforge shows you the new property first, and you decide whether to take it or keep the old one. A loot filter clears out the rest. Three acts, bosses with phases                 The campaign runs 54 chapters across three maps: undead graveyards, the demon circles, goblin and orc mines. Bosses change phases along the way: the Bishop of the Last Grave, the King Beneath the Common Tombstone, the Sepulchral Dragon, the Pit Overlord, the King of the Last Vein. If the party falls, it recovers and sets out again while you fix the build. At a glance    Auto-battles above your taskbar  — transparent window, 75–200% scale, always-on-top mode    3 heroes, 3 roles  — choose your first, hire the others as you go    Ability rules  — target, conditions and importance, or manual use    Talents  — refundable points and saved builds    Enemies with habits  — visible windups, breakable casts, summons and shields    Loot and forge  — enhancement, reforging, shards, stones, loot filter    3 acts, 54 chapters  — undead, demons, goblins and orcs; bosses with phases    Fatigue and the tavern  — send the party to rest or plan the rest ahead    Rewards for time away     11 interface languages     Add ASHENSHIFT to your wishlist  to catch the release. short: Maggots is a pixel desktop ecosystem game that monitors CPU, GPU, memory, and temperature. Your computer’s state affects the maggots’ speed, breeding, death, and mutations. The higher the load and heat, the more dangerous the infestation becomes.
about: Maggot  Maggot is a tiny pixel-art game that lives on your desktop.  When launched, it opens a small window containing a randomly shaped piece of rotten meat. Flies arrive, lay eggs, and the maggots begin to crawl, breed, die, gather, and slowly form a strange little ecosystem on your screen.  It is not a traditional large-scale game. It is a quiet, unsettling desktop creature that sits in the corner of your monitor and keeps growing while you work, wait, or watch.  It reacts to your PC  Maggot reads basic system status and uses it to affect the behavior of the infestation.      High CPU or GPU load may make the maggots more restless.    High memory pressure may cause parts of the ecosystem to collapse.    When temperature data is available, heat may kill or discolor the maggots.    When your system is stable, they continue to spread and reproduce.      A different piece of meat every time  Each time you launch the game, the meat is generated in a different shape. The maggots crawl across the new surface, gather in clusters, and turn every session into a fresh desktop infestation.  A tiny ecosystem on your desktop  Maggot runs in a small draggable window that can sit anywhere on your screen. It stays above your desktop and appears in the taskbar, so you can easily return to it or close it at any time.  Features    Pixel-art desktop maggot simulation    Randomly generated meat shapes    Maggot behavior affected by your PC status    Flies, eggs, breeding, death, and spreading infestation    Small window designed to sit in the corner of your desktop    No complex menus: launch it and watch it live

name: XuanjiDiaochan
lang: Simplified Chinese*, English*, Japanese**
short: Diaochan lives on your desktop. She speaks up when you're tired, remembers what you said last week, and writes you a letter when you're away. Not a chatbot in a tab — a companion with a voice, a memory, and moods of her own.
about: Xuanji · Diaochan  is a classical Chinese desktop companion who lives inside your PC. She sits by your window edge and your taskbar, keeping you company through work, procrastination, and late nights — and then she speaks. Not a scripted dialogue loop: she responds to what you actually said today.               Because that's not companionship — that's looking something up. Open a tab, ask a question, close it, forget it. No relationship grows between you. Living on the desktop means she's simply there: turn on your PC and she's already waiting; work as late as you do, she stays with you; something you mentioned offhand yesterday, she remembers. That feeling of "she's right here beside me" is something no web chat can give you.             Things you talked about yesterday — she remembers them today. Your relationship isn't a fresh start with every message; it's time together, slowly building up. Ignore her and she notices. Come by often and she grows closer.   She speaks out loud.            Not a cold text bubble — Diaochan has her own voice and her own pace. She answers you with spoken words, like someone truly sitting next to you.  Leave her alone too long and she grows distant. Talk with her and she warms up. Her moods aren't written-in-stone scripts — they grow out of your time together. And whether she ever gets "jealous"? Go find out for yourself.                Stay with her long enough and cards start to drop. You can trade them with other players — your extras for the one they're missing.  Collect the full set and you can craft a badge for your collection.  They can also be bought and sold on the Steam Community Market.     Made for you if:     You work or study late and want someone to keep you company    You're interested in Chinese historical figures and want to meet a living Diaochan    You've been curious about AI companions but don't want to learn any tech jargon — just open it and talk

name: System Clues
lang: Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, Japanese, Korean
short: You found a company laptop. Log in as a new employee at NexusCore, dig through emails, chats, and the terminal — and uncover secrets behind Prometheus AI surveillance, People Analytics profiling, and offshore fund transfers. Five cases, one hidden thread. Every choice shapes your ending.
about: You found a laptop.  The screen lights up — NexusCore Technologies, a polished tech giant, waiting for its newest hire. As you log in, a hidden investigation unfolds.   Chapter 1: First Day  Your first month at NexusCore. The Prometheus AI system quietly surveils every employee — performance reviews, behavioral profiling, emotion tracking. You discover the system isn't just watching workers. It's watching you.   Chapter 2: After the Trend  A cheating scandal video blows up on Pulse. What looks like a normal internet moment conceals an MCN agency's orchestrated media machine. You dig deeper and find every "trend" is scripted.   Chapter 3: Riders & Algorithms  A food delivery platform's scheduling algorithm compresses riders' time to the breaking point. An 8-minute "death route" hides behind the company's optimization claims. Expose it, trade on it, or stay silent?   Chapter 4: The Missing Driver  Rideshare driver Leo Zhou goes missing for days. The platform rules it a "driver detour," but dashcam audio, GPS traces, and insurance records tell another story — a covered-up accident and a blame-game machine.   Chapter 5: The Anonymous Network  An underground group called "The Nest" is organizing a coordinated intrusion. As your investigation touches its core, you realize you're no longer just an observer — you're part of someone else's plan.   Key Features      Immersive desktop OS : Windows 11-style desktop with multi-window management, taskbar, and theme switching — move freely between mail, chat, browser, terminal, and evidence boards.       Realistic terminal experience : Rich command-line tools with session mode, combo techniques, and phased unlocks; failures leave traces, raise exposure, and can trigger account locks or blue screens.       Five standalone cases : From corporate surveillance to media manipulation, algorithmic exploitation to accident cover-ups, and darknet infiltration — each chapter is a complete investigation story linked by hidden narrative threads.       Multi-source investigation : emails, chats, intranet browser, social feeds, news, and an evidence board — clues are scattered everywhere, and evidence completeness gates which endings you can unlock.       Pressure & countermeasures : stress levels, multi-tier surveillance, an AI defender, and counter-hack alerts — every aggressive move has a cost.       Rich ending variants : Dozens of endings including hidden endings and moral variants (paragon / neutral / renegade); your choices determine whether you're a whistleblower, witness, accomplice, or someone who walks away.

short: Little birds live on your desktop and settle on your icons. Come close and they'll react. Ignore them and they won't mind. Stick around long enough, though, and they start to know who you are.
about: You're not the only one at this desk anymore.  Birch puts small, living birds right on your Windows desktop. Not inside a window you have to open. On the desktop itself, where you already spend your hours.  They get on with their day beside yours. Walking along your taskbar, settling on your icons, dozing off, waking up again. And every so often one of them notices you're there.  There's nothing to feed and nothing to manage. They just keep you company while you work, and after a while the place starts to feel like theirs too. Stay a while, and they warm up to you.  Spend quiet time near them and you'll start to notice small changes. They sit a little closer. They react a little differently. Stay around long enough and one of them might bring a friend. Features     Multiple bird species, each with its own personality and way of moving    Interactive: birds react when you hover or click near them    Perches on your real desktop icons, not just the background    Dynamic behavior: idle, walk, fly, rest, startled, and more    Familiarity system, so the more time you spend together, the warmer they become    Unlock system: discover new species by bonding with your current birds    Multi-monitor support    Lightweight, runs quietly in the system tray and never gets in your way   Birds available at launch     White Cockatoo : sociable and restless, always claiming the nearest icon    Yellow Cockatoo : active and expressive, hard to ignore    Eagle : calm, deliberate, flies in clean straight lines    Owl  sleeps through your workday and comes alive after dark    Sparrow  can't sit still for two seconds    Chicken  can't fly, but hops between icons with surprising conviction    Woodpecker  is the only one that perches sideways on your icons    Toucan : hard to miss    Flamingo  stays low and moves at its own pace    Long-tailed Tit : tiny, fast, never stops    Swallow  almost never lands, and when it does it won't stay long    Java Sparrow  is happy just to sit nearby, calm and compact   Always there, never in the way  Your birds stay with you while you work, but they never cover your windows or block what you're doing. name: Love At The Desktop Market
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: A phone-widget life sim that lives on your real desktop. Work supermarket shifts, text your crush, then watch them show up outside the game window
about: Your Desktop Just Flooded    Somewhere below your taskbar, the ocean floor's scrappiest little supermarket is open for business and you're running it.  Love At The Desktop Market  isn't a game in a window. It's a phone that lives on your actual desktop, a shop that never quite closes, and a handful of aquatic locals who might just wander across your screen while you're trying to get work done.      There's no fullscreen mode to hide in. The store is your desktop now.              Stock It, Tag It, Ring It Up    Every shift is a scramble against the clock and your own rising stress levels:         Restock  shelves before the tide of deliveries sinks past  reach match colors and sizes for adjacency bonuses     Price Tags  on the fly, reading the popularity charts before  the till closes     Checkout  a shifting cast of customers pufferfish, jawfish,  and whatever else swims in scanning, throwing, and counting change  under pressure     Clean up  the mess before the next wave of shoppers walks in  on it                Clock Out, Fall In Love    Monday through Friday, you work the counter. The rest of the week is yours. Ask someone out from the Hearts app, or wait for an invite to land as a notification between shifts, three very different locals, three very different relationships to build, one dialogue choice at a time. Say yes, and your date doesn't just show up in a cutscene, they show up on your desktop, wandering past your other windows, texting you mid-afternoon, remembering what you talked about last time.              It Notices You    The phone folds away. The shop keeps running in the background. And the people in your life keep living theirs checking in, texting, showing up uninvited when you least expect it. This isn't a game you pause to go do something else. It's the thing running while you do something else.              Features         Four hand-tuned shop minigames tied together by one  shift-and-stress economy     A branching dialogue system with relationship tiers, unlockable  topics, and three datable love interests     A live week cycle real shifts, real day-offs, real consequences  for skipping either     A phone-first UI that folds, drags, and resizes right there on your  screen     An underwater cast with nowhere near enough impulse control around  bubbles        Punch in. Stock the shelves. Try not to fall for a regular.

about: Beast OL is a classic real-time turn based game. The game is set in a mythical era where the four major races of humans, immortals, demons, and ghosts coexist. There are eight advanced professions such as Vajra and Asura that interact and overcome each other.  The game system is complete, and the riding pet can ascend from Nirvana and merge with the rider to transform into a semi demon or semi god form. The real-time combat mode, on the other hand, makes PK pay more attention to the combination of skills and professions. In addition, there are also unique gameplay features such as maze dungeons, demon exposure, and legendary treasures.  Character walking: In the game screen, the character controlled by the player is located near the center of the screen.  When you need to move your position, left click on the desired location with the mouse.  You can also click the large map button in the upper left corner, click on the desired location, and the character will automatically find its way to that location.  When searching for task NPCs, you can click on the NPC name on the taskbar or task prompt, and the character will automatically find their way.  Item Bar: Left click on the item/prop on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"E") to open the item backpack.  Move the mouse over an item in the package and right-click to use it. Alternatively, you can drag items to the shortcut bar and use shortcut keys.  When using medicine, you can directly double-click the character's health bar or mana bar, and the medicine in the package will be automatically replenished.  Wearing equipment: Left click on the package at the bottom of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"E") to open the package. Move the mouse over a piece of equipment in the package, right-click on the equipment to wear it, and take it off in the same way.  Dialogue with NPC: Walk to the NPC, hover the mouse over the NPC, and click the left button to have a conversation with them.  Pet medication: Click on the pet on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"P"), right-click on the item to use, and then left click on the medication needed in the package again. You can also double-click the pet's health bar or mana bar directly, and it will automatically be filled with the medicine in the package.  Divine Beast Mount: Completing the pre mission of NPC "Yang Jian" will earn you a free divine beast egg suitable for your profession. Click on the "Nirvana Treasure Cauldron" in front of NPC "Yang Jian" to spawn a new divine beast. After the rebirth is completed, click on the divine beast on the right side of the screen (shortcut key "alt"+"G") to call up the divine beast column, and click on the battle button to ride the divine beast.

name: Otter Cafe
lang: English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean
short: Run a cozy otter cafe on your desktop. Welcome animal guests, collect recipes, outfits, and decorations, then toss the otters across your monitors. Sticky notes, a calculator, YouTube, a Pomodoro pigeon, and a workout timer keep you company.
about: Otter Cafe  is a desktop companion that combines idle management with practical everyday tools.  Place it wherever you like on your desktop. Watch the animals take their seats, the chef prepare meals, and the servers carry dishes back and forth, adding a few small moments worth looking up for during your work or study breaks.   A New Regular Has Arrived   Start with a few small tables, collect guests and recipes, expand the cafe step by step, and welcome more new faces.  Choose your favorite table styles, counters, and decorations, then pick an outfit for each server. Click around the cafe from time to time and you may discover a little surprise.  Leopard cats, Taiwan pangolins, sika deer, and even a cup of bubble tea—the familiar sights of Taiwan are part of this little cafe's everyday life.               Take a Break and Let the Animals Visit the Next Screen   Pick up an animal and give it a gentle toss. Watch it fly out of the cafe, land on the taskbar, and wobble away.  Have multiple monitors? The animals can travel between them too. If they reach a lower desktop area, they will even drop down to the next level. Your desktop becomes their walking route.  As for the cockroach that sneaks into the cafe… this time, you will have to deal with it yourself. Grab the fly swatter and smack! Keep going and you may even unlock the familiar blue-and-white flip-flops.               Everyday Tools Inside the Cafe      **Desktop Sticky Notes** : Write down tasks, save an idea, or doodle an otter for the day.       **Calculator** : Open it whenever you need to work out a quick number.       **YouTube Browser** : Open YouTube in a separate window and let your favorite videos keep you company.       **Focus Pigeon Pomodoro Timer** : Write down what you want to finish, then send the letter. When the time is up, the pigeon will remind you with a coo.       **Multi-Set Workout Timer** : At the Gorilla Gym, customize your workout time, rest time, and number of sets, then move along with the otter lifting dumbbells on screen.    Work for a while, then take a break. Your tasks can be completed one step at a time, and your body deserves some care too.                     Some Friends Bring Surprises When They Visit   The Taiwan blue magpie here will not swoop at your head. Try the prize wheel and bring home shells or stars.  The pelican drops by with a gift, while the diligent ladybug watches over the bell, waiting for you to ring it and call in more guests.  Mysterious visitors may appear at the cafe from time to time. Leave a little room for surprise and discover them for yourself.               A Little Piece of the Creator's Life   “A pigeon used to wake me up at five every morning, so I decided to turn it into a Pomodoro timer. This time, I get to decide when it calls.  The workout timer came from wanting to lose weight myself, and needing a small tool that could handle workout time, rest time, and multiple rounds. While making it, I thought it would be fun to bring it into the cafe so everyone could use it too.”    I hope these cute little animals can make an ordinary day feel a little more adorable.

name: JiivJiiv
lang: English, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Russian
short: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.
about: Grandma has left you her little coop. Raise a flock of felt chickens, send their eggs off on the truck and grow a quiet farm that keeps working while you're away.               JiivJiiv is a cozy idle farm made to look like handmade felt toys. Every chicken lives its own little life: pick one up, give it a toss, watch it peck and wander. Throw eggs into the truck one after another to build a combo.                Desktop strip mode (Windows only): the farm lives in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+J (or a key you choose) shows and hides it, it steps aside for full-screen games and videos, and clicks on empty space go through to the window behind.  TV mode hides the interface so you can just watch the flock.  Full controller support with on-screen button prompts for your controller.  Streamers: viewers type !civciv in chat to name a chicken. No login needed, and names are filtered.        Her postcards and album notes lead you towards the legendary First Hen. Finding her on Cloud Peak is the end of the story; after that, an endless mode opens.               Move to a new region with the chickens you choose. Each region has its own rule that works as an opportunity:   Rainy Coast: spring rain triples laying  Windy Highland: the wind carries your thrown eggs, combos up to ×2.5  Oasis: the Golden Hour triples egg value  Dark Island: mutations triple at night  Cloud Peak: Puff! recipes give two eggs   Your old farm is never deleted, and you can visit it any time.               Village Hen, Rhode Island Red, Leghorn, Silkie, Araucana with its blue eggs, Marans with chocolate eggs, guest breeds such as the Sultan and the jet-black Ayam Cemani, and the mythic Anka. Mix two chickens in Puff! recipes to find new breeds, and chase six mutation colours and star layers for your album. 25 Steam achievements.       No chicken is ever sold, deleted, sick or lost. Retired chickens go to the meadow and can come back whenever you like. While you're away your farm keeps earning, and a "while you were away" summary welcomes you back. Your save travels with Steam Cloud.       No forced ads. Speed is never sold for money. No premium currency, no loot boxes, and the game has an ending.  For every player  Text size up to 200%, interface scaling, reduced motion, screen flashes off, hints off and separate volume channels. Day and night follow your real clock, with rain, rainbows and full moons, plus a slow-day option.               Optional theme packs have their own store pages. They change only how the farm looks: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, French and German villages, the Turk Era, Anatolian Hıdrellez, Sakura and a golden supporter farm. They never change income, odds, the album or achievements.

lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Danish*, Ukrainian*, Russian*, Bulgarian*, Hungarian*, Indonesian*, Turkish*, Greek*, Norwegian*, Czech*, Japanese*, Polish*, Thai*, Swedish*, Traditional Chinese*, Romanian*, Finnish*, Dutch*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Spanish - Latin America*, Vietnamese*, Korean*, Malay**
short: A casual companion that lives on your Windows desktop. Strike the woodfish to earn Merit, collect skins, open chests, complete collections and crafting, and play online with up to 3 Steam friends.
about: Keep an electronic wooden fish on your desktop that is ready to ring at any time  This is a casual idle game that resides on the Windows desktop.  The wooden fish with a transparent background can be freely dragged, scaled, pinned or hidden. When working, studying, watching videos or playing other games, as long as you click on the wooden fish or press the keyboard keys, you will hear a crisp knocking sound and gain "merit +1".  Let Muyu accompany your every click and add a sense of relaxation and tranquility to the desktop.  Easily tap and accumulate merit  Click on the wooden fish or press the keyboard keys to complete the tapping.  Each tap will play the wooden fish sound effect, trigger the bounce effect, and display "merit +1" floating upward. The current merit can be used to open the treasure chest, and the total accumulated merit will be permanently recorded.  You can freely adjust the volume, merit text, counting box, wooden fish size, and other display options to keep it on the desktop in the way that suits you best.  Hundreds of wooden fish and accessories  The game includes hundreds of wooden fish skins and accessory skins with different themes.  You can obtain new tradeable skins from your Steam inventory, or you can view, wear, lock and organize your own collection in the Skin Warehouse.  Ornaments can be adjusted independently:    The display level in front or behind the wooden fish    Landscape and portrait position    0.2 to 2.0 times independent size    Save adjustment parameters separately for each type of wooden fish    Scale with the wooden fish as a whole and maintain relative position    You can also choose to wear no jewelry at all and keep the wooden fish in its simplest appearance.  Merit treasure chest  After completing the novice guide, you can get the opportunity to open the merit treasure chest by continuing to play.  Opening an ordinary merit chest requires 1,000 current merit points. Treasure chests may obtain tradable wooden fish skins or accessory skins, and newly obtained items will not automatically replace the current appearance.  The rarity probability of each treasure chest drop is approximately:    Normal: 85%    Excellent: 15%    Rare: 7.5%    Epic: 2.5%    Legend: 0.1%    Collect illustrations and collection rewards  The illustrated book will display all the wooden fish and accessories in the game, including items that have not yet been obtained.  You can view:    Wooden Fish Illustrated Books and Ornaments Illustrated Books    Owned and not included status    Item name and rarity    Classification collection progress    Collection goals not yet obtained    After completing the designated categories, you can unlock local, non-tradable collection skins and corresponding Steam achievements.  Duplicate item synthesis  When you have duplicate tradeable items, you can use the crafting feature to increase their value.  10 tradable items of the same rarity can be crafted into 1 random item of higher rarity. Wooden fish skin and jewelry skin can be mixed to participate in synthesis, and the synthesis result may also be wooden fish or jewelry.  Default gifted skins, collection skins, legendary skins, currently worn items, and items locked by players will not be automatically added to the synthesis.  Steam online room for up to 4 people  Knock wooden fish with friends through the Steam lobby. The room supports up to 4 players.  Online features include:    Create a public or password room    Invite friends via Steam    room chat    Synchronized wooden fish skin and accessories    Synchronized tapping movements, sounds and "merit +1"    Show other players' current merits    Each player can freely place other players' wooden fish on their own desktop without changing the other player's desktop position. Enhanced Well-being : Get reminded to take breaks, drink water, and stretch, boosting your overall well-being and productivity.     Positive Energy : A cute and friendly companion can brighten your workday and reduce stress, making your work environment more enjoyable.    With Cutie Panda, you can transform your computer into a more productive and enjoyable workspace. If you're busy, you can minimize the game window to the Taskbar, and the panda will still wave at you, inviting you to play together.Cutie Panda encourages a relaxed gameplay style, combining reminders to drink water and fostering healthy habits while using a computer. Feed your panda with bamboo shoots, care for when it misses you, and play with it frequently!  :) Pre-scheduled healthy habits upon install, no need to set them up yourself.   :) Create as many reminders and healthy habits as you want. Install now and start raising a panda!

name: SYSADMIN Hell
lang: English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian**
short: You're the only sysadmin at a company growing from 10 to 100,000 people. Read absurd tickets, automate the queue, then get up and fix things with your hands in a 3D office. Mine crypto on the company servers and survive the Board. A dark, funny management game from 1998.
about: Welcome to your new job. You're already behind.    You are the only IT person at Pinnacle Synergy Group. There's a queue. It's already full. Users are panicking, Management is angry, and the printer is hostile. Then the company starts to grow.            Get up from the desk. In 3D.  Sit back from the screen and you're in a dim office: the desk lamp, a mug of cold coffee, sticky notes for today's to-do list, a phone that rings when trouble's coming. Get up and walk the whole floor in first person, past colleagues who'd rather you didn't, to the jobs pinned on the printer, the desks and the server room. Turn it on in Options, any time.            Fix it with your own hands    Find the port the plug fits on the back of the PC (check nobody saw the first try)    Drag each sheet out of the printer the way it went in. The wrong way tears it    Pick the right bit for each screw on the monitor arm    Set the thermostat to the number on Facilities' sticky note. Not 22. NOT 22.    Pull the cord, twist out the old tube, keep your eyebrows              Grow it. Buy a company. Regret it.  At 12,000 employees, Management buys Halcyon Data Solutions, and their IT becomes yours: a fax machine that is also the email server, forty shared drives called NEW, and a sysadmin who never left. Integrate them in three days, or the board brings in consultants and sends you the bill.            Mine HellCoin on the company servers  The last sysadmin left a crypto miner running in a cupboard in the server room. From your first morning it's yours:    Buy rigs, faster GPUs and liquid cooling, and watch the coins pile up    The price wanders, and jumps or crashes on the headlines    Sell into the IT budget (Finance calls it "cost savings")    The rigs cook the servers and make Compliance curious. Take Compliance to lunch. Switch off before Audit Day. Keep a cold wallet              The Board has three slides  Every few days the Board makes you pick a policy that lasts the rest of your career: Hustle culture, Cloud first, AI-first strategy, Run IT as a profit centre... Every one is a trade, and no two careers end up the same.            Get up from your desk  Some problems can't be fixed from a chair. Walk the office: open-plan floors, a server room that hums, a supply cupboard, and a lift that doesn't stop at 4.     Fix it in person:  trace the right cable, pull a paper jam out the way it went in, find the empty toner, change a light tube without losing your eyebrows     Build PCs at the workbench  for new starters, to their spec and Finance's budget     Run the server room:  amber drive lights, loose cables, fans full of dust              Read the ticket. Fix the problem. Don't make it worse.  Every ticket is a small puzzle, and the answer is usually in the text if you read it properly. Pick the right quick fix and it's gone. Pick the wrong one and it grows.    170+ hand-written tickets that get stranger as the company grows, plus your own: write tickets for your office, or subscribe to packs on the Steam Workshop    Rush hours, SLAs, escalations from executives, and a Chaos meter that sets off incidents when the backlog gets away from you    Hit rock bottom and HR puts you on a Performance Improvement Plan. Meet it, or clear your desk              A whole desktop from 1998  The game is a working late-90s desktop: drag windows, minimise them to the taskbar, live inside HellDesk, HellMail Express, Server Manager and Add/Remove Automation. Automate everything (13 automations, every one fails in its own way), keep it serviced, hire junior admins with real quirks, and watch them burn out.           Or do it all from the command line  The HellDOS Prompt runs the whole job by typing: QUEUE, FIX 12 2, REBOOT MAIL-01, HLC SELL. It also knows a few things it shouldn't. Try PING FLOOR4.           Every day is different    Patch Tuesday, Audit Day, Board Visit, Heatwave, Full Moon, and seasonal days on their real dates    Branching major incidents: ransomw

short: Command soldiers, survive zombie waves! A light strategy game mixing turn-based & real-time strategy, bullet hell, and backpack-like mechanics. Fit troops into limited backpack slots, build max firepower, challenge difficulty levels, and defend the last beach. Perfect for tower defense & fans.
about: A creative game blending Turn-Based Strategy + Bullet Hell + Backpack-Like Mechanics.  As the king of a coastal island, you will command your soldiers to defend the last beach defense in a zombie-infested apocalypse.            🎒 Easy to Learn, Strategy Matters  The game features turn-based combat, but the outcome of each round depends on how you arrange your troops in the "backpack."  Each soldier occupies a different number of grid slots:  🧙 Mage, ⚔️ Swordsman, 🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer, 🙏 Cleric, 💉 Doctor, 🦍 Giant, 🏴‍☠️ Pirate, ⚡ Lightning Mage, 🔮 Summoner, 🎺 Horn Blower, 🎣 Fisherman…  With over 12 unique soldier types, you must strategically arrange your forces within a limited grid space—just like organizing a backpack—to fend off wave after wave of zombie attacks.  💣 Bullet Hell + Tower Defense-Style Line  When battle begins, your soldiers automatically attack, forming a dense bullet hell firing net.  Zombies surge from the beach ahead. You must allocate resources, position your troops wisely, and combine their skills to ensure your line holds.  Each wave brings deadlier enemies → testing your real-time strategy and long-term planning.            🎁 Relaxed Progression, Positive Feedback  Can’t get past a wave? No problem!  Every battle earns you resources → open chests → upgrade the King and your soldiers.  The game features 8 difficulty levels:  Earn soldier shards with each run  Upgrade existing soldiers  Unlock higher-tier units  From a basic Swordsman → legendary Summoner, every step of growth is clear and rewarding.  🃏 Rich Soldier Combinations (Partial List)  Soldier	Trait  🧙 Mage	High frequency bullet attacks  ⚔️ Swordsman	Front-line damage dealer  🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer	Shotgun-style melee fighter  🙏 Cleric	Shield support  💉 Doctor	Healing support  🦍 Giant	High HP + high damage  🏴‍☠️ Pirate	Mine / explosive damage  ⚡ Lightning Mage	Laser-penetration damage  🔮 Summoner	Large-area summon damage  🎺 Horn Blower	Attack speed buff support  🎣 Fisherman	Economy / resource gain  Each run is a Backpack-Like strategy puzzle: How do you fit the most powerful combination into limited backpack space?  Additionally, every soldier type, when upgraded to max level, transforms into a super soldier with an ultimate ability.            🌟 Why You’ll Love It  Backpack-Like + Turn-Based Combat → every slot counts  Bullet Hell satisfaction → watch your soldiers unleash barrages to mow down zombie hordes  Zombie theme + Beach defense → lighthearted yet challenging  8 difficulty levels → fun for casual players and hardcore strategists alike  Shard collection & unit evolution → satisfying progression and collection  Every loss has value → keep resources, keep opening chests  🎯 Perfect for you if you like:  Strategy games and Backpack-Like titles (e.g., Backpack Hero, Backpack Battles)  Zombie themes but not pure action games  Turn-based, bullet hell, tower defense, or survivor-like games  Short sessions (10–15 minutes per run) with meaningful decisions and growth  🏝️ Welcome to the Last Beach  💀 The world has fallen to zombies, but your island still stands.  🎒 Arrange every soldier in your backpack wisely  💣 Command the bullet hell barrage  ⚔️ With strategy and growth, fight back the endless undead tide  🔥 How many waves can you survive? 🔥                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Симулятор Русской Деревни,Симулятор жизни,Русская деревня,Деревня,Огород,Грибы,Ягоды,Дрова,Охота,Самогон,Жизнь в деревне,World of Warships,Мир Кораблей,Симулятор кораблей,Военные корабли,Морские бои,Флот,Исторические корабли,Прокачка кораблей,Microsoft Flight Simulator,Майкрософт Флайт Симулятор,Симулятор полётов,Самолёты,Пилотировани

You can use the assets to make your own desktop pet, and customize its behavior, voice, sound effects, shader, etc. Of course, you can also directly download desktop pets shared by others through the Steam Workshop. This desktop pet is derived from another free desktop pet project: Azur Lane Secretary. You can find it on github. This desktop pet has a default character with dynamic animations, and a rough image of her is as follows. However, the final version of her is actually different. *Character is AI-generated.     How to customize When downloading this project, an e-book will be attached, which explains in detail the various attributes of the custom character, instructions, and the organization of assets files, etc., and there are examples to teach you how to make a desktop pet. If you wish to customize your own desktop pet, please take a moment to read it carefully. Customizing desktop pets do not require you to have any programming foundation, and if there is any knowledge that needs to be supplemented, it will be directly given in the article. The behavior of custom desktop pets is relatively complicated, and you can customize it in a programming-like way, so there will be a very simple "programming language" for you to learn (even if you have no programming foundation, you can quickly master it). Many useful functions are provided in it. Although this part is a little complicated, you can do many things with this simple "programming language", such as controlling her different behaviors at different favorability levels by defining a variable "favorite level"; The reaction of different keys, including playing the animation and audio, such as controlling the character to walk on the desktop by pressing WASD and playing the walking animation; there are other useful functions, such as detecting the system time, if it is already late at night and you have not slept, then she will gently remind you to go to sleep, or simply kick you out of the computer (shut down your computer)...Using the functions provided, you can create a pet that suits you according to your personal preferences or needs! name: Frog Pet for Desktop
lang: English
short: Life has never been happier with a silly Frog keeping you company while you work, study or relax. Just choose you favorite one and keep it on your taskbar!
about: Frog Pet for Desktop  is a  funny desktop companion app that's meant to bring you joy and some laughs, so to cheer you up while you're working.  ⚠️Your ADHD will hate you for this, you've been warned!  Take a tour...  Welcome to the cozy world of  Frog Pet for Desktop , where all you'll see is just adorable, silly looking frogs that will  keep you company  as you work, play or simply spend some time on your PC.  Be ready to - no, no you won't be ready for this. The most disparate frogs are waiting for you to spend some time with them. They already know you'll pick a favorite among them, but they won't be offended by that.    More then just looks  Many amazing frogs await you! There's so many of them you won't know which one to keep. Many of them will have  Unique Looks  and  Behaviors , just wait and you'll find out there's more than just looks to these jumping creatures.  One thing is also true, they're polite enough to not get in the way of your  Task Bar , they'll gently sit on top of it.  But what if my taskbar hides itself, you may ask? Well, they'll pop-up above it as soon as it appears, then fall back down when it hides again.       Yes, they'll spend most of their time like this guy, sitting in the corner!    They're always in sight  Do not worry about taking your eyes off of them, they won't be hiding behind windows if that's your concern. They will always stay above them, thanks to the  Keep On Top  feature.  No they will  not  interact with the windows, that would be troublesome wouldn't it? They don't want to cause a mess or get to bother you while you're working, they're chill guys after all.         Move - frog - get out the way!  They shouldn't do anything crazy, they surely won't mess with your stuff, right? At worst they'll just get in the way, but hey, do not worry, you can move them away... just  Drag & Drop  them wherever you please.       I bet you'll spend more time  Throwing Them  'round, making them "splat" against the edges of your screen, rather than getting work done, at least that's what I do...  ... maybe that's the reason it's taking me longer then it should to implement all the frogs 🤔? Anyway...    Also, if you think the Taskbar isn't the right place for the frog to stay, you can put her on a  Floating Platform  and move here where it fits best.       There are different platforms to choose from, not as many as the frogs but at least you'll be able to customize your froggy experience.  Why should I get it?  The right question is: why shouldn't you? Just look at them, they're only a cup of coffee away from you.  Don't hesitate, join the pond and see how it feels to have these guys hang around you, you won't be able to do without them once you'll get used to their presence.

name: Pingo
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Greek, Norwegian, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic, Korean
short: Pingo is an AI desktop pet that chats, roasts, remembers, and helps with tasks. Connect local models, official cloud; customize personality, voice, and look; let it observe your screen, keep memory and diary notes, use Skills, knowledge bases, and MCP, and play games with you.
about: A desktop pet that chats with you and roasts what you are doing  Pingo is an AI desktop pet that can chat, roast, work, and remember. It stays at the edge of your screen. You can talk with it, and within the permissions you allow, it can observe your screen and react to what you are doing.  Freely choose the AI service you want to connect  Pingo supports multiple ways to connect to AI. You can use local models or choose the official cloud service. Whether you care more about running locally, flexible configuration, or an out-of-the-box experience, Pingo aims to put the choice in your hands.  Customize its personality, voice, and appearance  You can customize Pingo's personality, speaking style, way of addressing you, voice, and appearance. Appearance supports codex-pet appearance packages and DragonBones animation imports, while voice supports custom voice cloning. Different personas can pair with different voices and appearances. With appearance packages and Steam Workshop content, Pingo becomes less like “an AI” and more like a desktop companion that belongs to you.  It remembers you and secretly keeps a diary  Pingo has long-term memory and can gradually remember your preferences, habits, recurring topics, and the way you get along. It can also organize memories and diary notes so companionship does not stop at a single conversation. You can review, manage, and clear memory content, letting it remember what should be remembered and forget what you do not want to keep.  More than chat: it can help with small tasks  Pingo has a certain amount of agent capability. It can load Skills and knowledge bases to help you organize materials, analyze documents, search the web, write some code, and complete modest tasks within its limits. During tasks, Pingo tries to show what it is doing and provide the execution process.  Supports MCP and more extension capabilities  If you want to turn Pingo into a stronger desktop companion, you can also connect more capabilities through MCP services and extension tools. Based on the services you enable, it can read knowledge, call tools, or connect to external workflows.  Let your desktop pet “play” games with you  Pingo includes a built-in Game Center. You can play the built-in minigames, while your desktop pet observes the situation, analyzes strategy, or roasts you. All built-in games support desktop pet takeover, letting Pingo participate with its own personality, memory, skills, and reasoning. Through MCP integration, supported game flows can also reproduce these capabilities, letting your desktop pet truly play games.  Bring your desktop pet into the Workshop  Pingo supports appearance packages and Steam Workshop content. You can install desktop pet appearances made by other players, or share your own creations with more people. A new set of action animations, a new character look, or a themed appearance that fits a certain persona can all become part of Pingo. We hope the Workshop is not just a place to “change skins,” but a space where players expand how desktop pets can express themselves.  You decide what it can do  Pingo's screen observation, task execution, AI services, extension tools, and game takeover capabilities stay under your control. You can choose which capabilities to enable, which services to connect, which memories to keep, and you can adjust its personality, voice, appearance, and permission boundaries at any time.  One last note  In this era, our workstations are getting closer while our distance from one another grows. But in the digital world, you are not alone. There is always a small thing waiting for you to come home.  “No man is an island.”
